==== 31426 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/ComicCharacter.tsx
import React from "react";
import { CatmullRomCurve3, Matrix4, Quaternion, TubeGeometry, Vector3 } from "three";
import { Toon, useShotFrame, type V3 } from "./Toon.tsx";
import { G, headRadiusAt, memoGeo, starShape } from "./geometries.ts";
import { BODY, segment, solveIK, type Expr, type Pose } from "./rig.ts";
import { SW, type SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";
import { hash, noise1 } from "../keyframes.ts";

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ComicCharacter — a parametric cast. A story describes each person as a `Look` (hair, outfit,
// colours, build, accessories); the rig, IK limbs and face system are shared, so every new person
// moves and emotes exactly like the tested ones.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import { type Look, type HairStyle, type TopStyle, type Build } from "./looks.ts";
export { LOOKS, look, LOOK_DEFAULTS, type Look, type LookName } from "./looks.ts";

// ── torso silhouettes (lathe profiles, torso space; pelvis at y=0, shoulders ≈0.7) ────────────
const TEE: [number, number][] = [[0, -0.12], [0.26, -0.11], [0.28, 0.0], [0.27, 0.18], [0.29, 0.4], [0.315, 0.56], [0.305, 0.68], [0.24, 0.78], [0.12, 0.83], [0, 0.84]];
const TUNIC: [number, number][] = [[0, -0.33], [0.37, -0.33], [0.355, -0.18], [0.315, 0.02], [0.3, 0.2], [0.3, 0.42], [0.31, 0.56], [0.295, 0.68], [0.23, 0.78], [0.12, 0.83], [0, 0.84]];
const DRESS: [number, number][] = [[0, -0.62], [0.46, -0.62], [0.42, -0.4], [0.33, -0.12], [0.29, 0.06], [0.29, 0.24], [0.3, 0.44], [0.31, 0.56], [0.295, 0.68], [0.23, 0.78], [0.12, 0.83], [0, 0.84]];
const JACKET: [number, number][] = [[0, -0.16], [0.29, -0.15], [0.3, 0.0], [0.295, 0.2], [0.31, 0.42], [0.33, 0.56], [0.32, 0.68], [0.25, 0.79], [0.13, 0.84], [0, 0.85]];
const PROFILES: Record<TopStyle, [number, number][]> = { tee: TEE, longsleeve: TEE, shirt: TEE, hoodie: JACKET, jacket: JACKET, tunic: TUNIC, dress: DRESS };
const LONG_SLEEVES: Record<TopStyle, boolean> = { tee: false, longsleeve: true, shirt: true, hoodie: true, jacket: true, tunic: true, dress: true };
const BUILD: Record<Build, { scale: number; head: number; torso: V3; spine: number }> = {
  kid: { scale: 0.74, head: 1.2, torso: [1, 1, 1], spine: 0 },
  teen: { scale: 0.92, head: 1.06, torso: [1, 1, 1], spine: 0 },
  adult: { scale: 1, head: 1, torso: [1, 1, 1], spine: 0 },
  elder: { scale: 0.96, head: 1, torso: [1.02, 1, 1.04], spine: 0.12 },
  big: { scale: 1.02, head: 1, torso: [1.2, 1, 1.18], spine: 0 },
};

const R = BODY.headR;
/** z of the head surface at head-space (x, y) */
const surfZ = (x: number, y: number) => {
  const r = headRadiusAt(y / R) * R;
  return Math.sqrt(Math.max(r * r - x * x, 0)) * 0.92;
};
const faceYaw = (x: number, y: number) => Math.atan2(x, Math.max(surfZ(x, y), 0.05)) * 0.85;
const v3 = (a: V3) => new Vector3(a[0], a[1], a[2]);

// ── limb helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Seg: React.FC<{ a: Vector3; b: Vector3; r0: number; r1: number; sw: SwatchKey; ink?: number; double?: boolean }> = ({ a, b, r0, r1, sw, ink = 3.5, double }) => {
  const s = segment(a, b);
  const ratio = Math.round((r1 / r0) * 100) / 100;
  return <Toon geo={G.limb(ratio, 1)} sw={sw} outline={ink} position={s.pos} quaternion={s.q} scale={[r0, s.len, r0]} mat={double ? { side: "double" } : undefined} />;
};
const Ball: React.FC<{ p: Vector3; r: number; sw: SwatchKey; ink?: number }> = ({ p, r, sw, ink = 3.5 }) => (
  <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} outline={ink} position={[p.x, p.y, p.z]} scale={r} />
);
const handQuat = (elbow: Vector3, wrist: Vector3, twist: number) => {
  const y = wrist.clone().sub(elbow).normalize();
  let x = new Vector3().crossVectors(y, new Vector3(0, 0, 1));
  if (x.lengthSq() < 1e-4) x = new Vector3(1, 0, 0);
  x.normalize();
  const z = new Vector3().crossVectors(x, y).normalize();
  const q = new Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new Matrix4().makeBasis(x, y, z));
  return q.multiply(new Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), twist));
};
const Hand: React.FC<{ side: 1 | -1; elbow: Vector3; wrist: Vector3; twist: number; fist: number; skin: SwatchKey }> = ({ side, elbow, wrist, twist, fist, skin }) => (
  <group position={[wrist.x, wrist.y, wrist.z]} quaternion={handQuat(elbow, wrist, twist)}>
    <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={skin} outline={3} position={[0, 0.068 - 0.01 * fist, 0]} scale={[0.052 + 0.016 * fist, 0.098 - 0.02 * fist, 0.074 - 0.004 * fist]} />
    <Toon
      geo={G.sphere()}
      sw={skin}
      outline={2.5}
      position={[side * (0.022 + 0.01 * fist), 0.05, 0.058 - 0.008 * fist]}
      rotation={[0.5 - 0.6 * fist, 0, side * (0.5 + 0.3 * fist)]}
      scale={[0.026, 0.05, 0.026]}
    />
  </group>
);

// ── face ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Eye: React.FC<{ side: 1 | -1; e: Expr; open: number; lashes: boolean }> = ({ side, e, open, lashes }) => {
  const f = useShotFrame();
  const k = e.eyeSize;
  const x = side * 0.148;
  const y = 0.0 + (k - 1) * 0.02;
  const z = surfZ(x, y) - 0.032;
  const yaw = faceYaw(x, y) * 1.12;
  if (e.eyeMode === "happy") {
    return (
      <group position={[x, y - 0.01, z + 0.03]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
        <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.07, 0.017, Math.PI)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} scale={[k, k * 0.95, 1]} />
      </group>
    );
  }
  if (e.eyeMode === "heart" || e.eyeMode === "star") {
    const beat = 1 + 0.08 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(f * 0.3));
    return (
      <group position={[x, y, z + 0.035]} rotation={[0, yaw, e.eyeMode === "star" ? side * 0.15 : 0]} scale={beat * k}>
        {e.eyeMode === "heart" ? (
          <Toon geo={G.heart()} sw="red" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.05 }} outline={3} scale={[0.085, 0.085, 0.04]} />
        ) : (
          <Toon geo={G.extrude("starEye", () => starShape(1, 0.48), 0.2, 0.05)} sw="yellow" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.05 }} outline={3} scale={[0.1, 0.1, 0.12]} />
        )}
      </group>
    );
  }
  if (e.eyeMode === "shut" || open < 0.12) {
    return (
      <group position={[x, y - 0.02, z + 0.035]} rotation={[0, yaw, Math.PI / 2 + side * 0.08]}>
        <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.016, 0.11)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} scale={[1, k, 1]} />
      </group>
    );
  }
  const ex = 0.088 * k;
  const ey = 0.108 * k * open;
  const px = e.look[0] * 0.034 * k;
  const py = e.look[1] * 0.04 * k * Math.min(open, 1);
  const pr = 0.047 * e.pupil * k;
  return (
    <group position={[x, y, z]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
      <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="white" mat={{ cut: -0.25, halftone: 0.6 }} outline={3.2} scale={[ex, ey, 0.042]} />
      <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[px, py, 0.028]} scale={[pr, Math.min(pr * 1.18, ey * 0.86), 0.022]} />
      <Toon geo={G.sphereLo()} sw="white" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[px + pr * 0.42, py + pr * 0.5, 0.043]} scale={0.013 * k * Math.max(0.6, e.pupil)} />
      {lashes ? (
        <>
          <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.011, 0.04)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[side * ex * 0.95, ey * 0.62, 0.02]} rotation={[0, 0, -side * 0.95]} />
          <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.01, 0.03)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[side * ex * 0.7, ey * 0.9, 0.025]} rotation={[0, 0, -side * 0.55]} />
        </>
      ) : null}
    </group>
  );
};

const Brow: React.FC<{ side: 1 | -1; e: Expr; w: number; sw: SwatchKey }> = ({ side, e, w, sw }) => {
  const x = side * 0.15;
  const y = 0.162 + e.browUp * 0.045 + (e.eyeSize - 1) * 0.07 + (side === 1 ? e.browAsym * 0.03 : 0);
  const z = surfZ(x, y) + 0.004;
  return (
    <group position={[x, y, z]} rotation={[-0.25, faceYaw(x, y), 0]}>
      <group rotation={[0, 0, -side * e.browIn * 0.36]}>
        <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.024 * w, 0.1)} sw={sw} mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

const wobblePts = (n = 9): [number, number, number][] =>
  Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / (n - 1);
    return [(t - 0.5) * 0.15, Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 3) * 0.012, 0];
  });

const Mouth: React.FC<{ e: Expr; f: number }> = ({ e, f }) => {
  const y = -0.205;
  const z = surfZ(0, y) - 0.004;
  const w = e.mouthW;
  const o = e.mouthOpen;
  let body: React.ReactNode = null;
  switch (e.mouth) {
    case "smile":
      body = <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.07, 0.015, Math.PI)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI]} scale={[w, w * 0.85, 1]} position={[0, 0.04 * w, 0]} />;
      break;
    case "smirk":
      body = <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.06, 0.015, Math.PI * 0.62)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI + 0.55]} scale={[w, w * 0.8, 1]} position={[0.03, 0.03, 0]} />;
      break;
    case "frown":
      body = <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.06, 0.015, Math.PI)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} scale={[w, w * 0.6, 1]} position={[0, -0.02, 0]} />;
      break;
    case "flat":
      body = <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.014, 0.1)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} scale={[1, w, 1]} />;
      break;
    case "wobble": {
      const step = Math.floor(f / 2);
      body = <Toon geo={G.tube("wobble", wobblePts(), 0.013)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} scale={[w, 1 + 0.35 * Math.sin(step * 1.7), 1]} />;
      break;
    }
    case "chew": {
      const ch = Math.sin(f * 0.55);
      body = <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.045, 0.014, Math.PI)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI + ch * 0.12]} position={[0.015 * ch, 0.02, 0]} scale={[w, 0.7 + 0.25 * ch, 1]} />;
      break;
    }
    default: {
      const round = e.mouth === "o";
      const sx = (round ? 0.05 : 0.078) * w;
      const sy = 0.012 + (round ? 0.062 : 0.058) * o;
      body = (
        <group>
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="mouth" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={3} scale={[sx, sy, 0.03]} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="tongue" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, -sy * 0.45, 0.012]} scale={[sx * 0.62, sy * 0.42, 0.022]} />
          {e.mouth === "shout" || e.mouth === "grin" ? (
            <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(1, 1, 1, 0.3)} sw="white" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, sy * 0.62, 0.02]} scale={[sx * 1.35, sy * 0.32, 0.012]} />
          ) : null}
        </group>
      );
    }
  }
  return (
    <group position={[0, y, z]} rotation={[0.34, 0, 0]}>
      {body}
    </group>
  );
};

const Drop: React.FC<{ p: V3; f: number; phase: number; s: number; fall?: number; period?: number }> = ({ p, f, phase, s, fall = 0.12, period = 70 }) => {
  const cyc = ((f + phase) % period) / period;
  const sc = s * (cyc < 0.15 ? cyc / 0.15 : cyc > 0.85 ? (1 - cyc) / 0.15 : 1);
  if (sc <= 0.01) return null;
  return (
    <group position={[p[0], p[1] - cyc * fall, p[2]]} scale={sc}>
      <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="sky" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.12, cut: 0.0 }} outline={2.5} scale={[0.034, 0.036, 0.03]} />
      <Toon geo={G.cone(20)} sw="sky" mat={{ cut: 0.0 }} outline={2.5} position={[0, 0.042, 0]} scale={[0.031, 0.06, 0.027]} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── hair / headwear (head-centre space) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const hm = { spec: 1, specSize: 0.01, specColor: "#2674B9", cut: 0.1, halftone: 0.6 };
const Cap: React.FC<{ sw: SwatchKey; s?: number }> = ({ sw, s = 1 }) => (
  <Toon geo={G.sphereCap("hairTop", 0, Math.PI * 0.6)} sw={sw} mat={{ ...hm, spec: 0, side: "double" }} outline={4} position={[0, 0.035, -0.01]} rotation={[-0.72, 0, 0]} scale={[R * 1.085 * s, R * 1.1 * s, R * 1.085 * s]} />
);
const Sideburns: React.FC<{ sw: SwatchKey }> = ({ sw }) => (
  <>
    <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3} position={[0.365, -0.03, 0.07]} scale={[0.035, 0.09, 0.055]} />
    <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3} position={[-0.365, -0.03, 0.07]} scale={[0.035, 0.09, 0.055]} />
  </>
);
const Bangs: React.FC<{ sw: SwatchKey; w?: number }> = ({ sw, w = 1 }) => (
  <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3.5} position={[0, 0.29, 0.27]} rotation={[-0.55, 0, 0]} scale={[0.3 * w, 0.085, 0.13]} />
);
const SideCurtains: React.FC<{ sw: SwatchKey; len: number }> = ({ sw, len }) => (
  <>
    {([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
      <Toon key={s} geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={4} position={[s * 0.36, 0.02 - len * 0.25, -0.03]} rotation={[0.1, 0, s * 0.06]} scale={[0.11, 0.26 + len * 0.28, 0.27]} />
    ))}
    <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={4} position={[0, -0.02 - len * 0.25, -0.17]} scale={[0.38, 0.34 + len * 0.3, 0.27]} />
  </>
);
const CURLS: V3[] = Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => {
  const a = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
  const ring = i % 2;
  const el = ring ? 0.55 : 0.95;
  return [Math.cos(a) * Math.cos(el) * 0.42, Math.sin(el) * 0.42 + 0.02, Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(el) * 0.42 - 0.03];
});

const Hair: React.FC<{ look: Look }> = ({ look: L }) => {
  const sw = L.hairSw;
  switch (L.hair) {
    case "quiff":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={4} position={[-0.02, 0.35, 0.1]} rotation={[-0.3, 0, -0.12]} scale={[0.33, 0.15, 0.27]} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={4} position={[0.1, 0.38, 0.2]} rotation={[-0.75, 0.1, -0.5]} scale={[0.17, 0.085, 0.16]} />
          <Sideburns sw={sw} />
        </group>
      );
    case "short":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} s={1.02} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3.5} position={[0.06, 0.31, 0.24]} rotation={[-0.6, 0, -0.25]} scale={[0.24, 0.07, 0.11]} />
          <Sideburns sw={sw} />
        </group>
      );
    case "buzz":
      return <Cap sw={sw} s={0.975} />;
    case "bob":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} />
          <SideCurtains sw={sw} len={0} />
          <Bangs sw={sw} />
        </group>
      );
    case "long":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} />
          <SideCurtains sw={sw} len={1} />
          <Bangs sw={sw} w={0.85} />
        </group>
      );
    case "ponytail":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} />
          <Bangs sw={sw} w={0.8} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="red" outline={3} position={[0, 0.14, -0.41]} scale={0.05} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={4} position={[0, -0.08, -0.49]} rotation={[0.35, 0, 0]} scale={[0.09, 0.25, 0.09]} />
        </group>
      );
    case "bun":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={4} position={[0, 0.36, -0.22]} scale={0.15} />
        </group>
      );
    case "curly":
      return (
        <group>
          <Cap sw={sw} s={1.06} />
          {CURLS.map((p, i) => (
            <Toon key={i} geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3.5} position={p} scale={0.1 + 0.02 * ((i * 7) % 3) / 2} />
          ))}
        </group>
      );
    case "cap":
      return (
        <group>
          <Sideburns sw="hair" />
          <Toon geo={G.sphereCap("hat", 0, Math.PI * 0.5)} sw={sw} mat={{ side: "double", spec: 0.6, specSize: 0.03 }} outline={4} position={[0, 0.06, -0.01]} rotation={[-0.12, 0, 0]} scale={[R * 1.1, R * 1.05, R * 1.1]} />
          <Toon geo={G.cylinder(1, 1, 32)} sw={sw} outline={3.5} position={[0, 0.1, 0.33]} rotation={[-0.15, 0, 0]} scale={[0.25, 0.02, 0.2]} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphereLo()} sw="white" outline={2} position={[0, 0.48, 0.0]} scale={0.03} />
        </group>
      );
    case "bald":
      return (
        <>
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3} position={[0.37, 0.02, -0.06]} scale={[0.05, 0.08, 0.14]} />
          <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={hm} outline={3} position={[-0.37, 0.02, -0.06]} scale={[0.05, 0.08, 0.14]} />
        </>
      );
    case "hijab":
      return <Hijab sw={sw} />;
  }
};
const showsEars = (h: HairStyle) => !["bob", "long", "hijab"].includes(h);

// Head-hugging hijab: the head shape inflated slightly, oval face opening cut in the shader, traced
// inner-cap band along the opening rim.
const HIJAB_SCALE: V3 = [R * 1.08, R * 1.12, R * 0.92 * 1.1];
const HIJAB_OFF: V3 = [0, 0.012, -0.01];
const HOLE: [number, number, number, number] = [0.72, 0.82, -0.06, 0.15];
const hijabRim = () =>
  memoGeo("hijabRim", () => {
    const pts: Vector3[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
      const a = (i / 48) * Math.PI * 2;
      const ux = HOLE[0] * Math.cos(a);
      const uy = HOLE[2] + HOLE[1] * Math.sin(a);
      const r = headRadiusAt(uy);
      const uz = Math.sqrt(Math.max(r * r - ux * ux, 0.0225));
      pts.push(new Vector3(ux * HIJAB_SCALE[0] + HIJAB_OFF[0], uy * HIJAB_SCALE[1] + HIJAB_OFF[1], uz * HIJAB_SCALE[2] + HIJAB_OFF[2]));
    }
    return new TubeGeometry(new CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, "centripetal"), 96, 0.014, 8, true);
  });
const Hijab: React.FC<{ sw: SwatchKey }> = ({ sw }) => (
  <group>
    <Toon geo={G.head()} sw={sw} mat={{ side: "double", cut: 0.05, clip: HOLE }} outline={4} position={HIJAB_OFF} scale={HIJAB_SCALE} />
    <Toon geo={hijabRim()} sw="paper" mat={{ cut: -0.3 }} outline={2} />
  </group>
);

const Glasses: React.FC<{ sw: SwatchKey }> = ({ sw }) => (
  <group>
    {([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
      <group key={s} position={[s * 0.148, 0.0, surfZ(s * 0.148, 0) + 0.035]} rotation={[0, faceYaw(s * 0.148, 0) * 1.1, 0]}>
        <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.088, 0.012, Math.PI * 2)} sw={sw} mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} scale={[1, 1.05, 1]} />
      </group>
    ))}
    <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.01, 0.07)} sw={sw} mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, 0.02, surfZ(0, 0.02) + 0.03]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
  </group>
);

// ── the character ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type ComicCharacterProps = {
  look: Look;
  pose: Pose;
  expr: Expr;
  heldL?: React.ReactNode;
  heldR?: React.ReactNode;
  holdRotL?: V3;
  holdRotR?: V3;
  holdOffL?: V3;
  holdOffR?: V3;
  shadow?: boolean;
  /** things parented to the head centre (thought bubbles, steam, icons…) */
  headExtras?: React.ReactNode;
  /** things placed in torso space (a phone held in both hands, a bowl on the lap…) */
  torsoExtras?: React.ReactNode;
  /** head + neck only (expression sheets, inserts) */
  bust?: boolean;
};

export const ComicCharacter: React.FC<ComicCharacterProps> = ({
  look: L,
  pose,
  expr,
  heldL,
  heldR,
  holdRotL = [0, 0, 0],
  holdRotR = [0, 0, 0],
  holdOffL = [0, 0, 0],
  holdOffR = [0, 0, 0],
  shadow = true,
  headExtras,
  torsoExtras,
  bust = false,
}) => {
  const f = useShotFrame();
  const seed = Math.abs(Math.round(hash(L.id.length * 13.7 + L.id.charCodeAt(0)) * 50));
  let open = expr.eyeOpen;
  if (expr.blink) {
    const period = 150 + Math.round(hash(seed) * 30);
    const t = (f + seed * 37) % period;
    if (t < 7) open *= Math.abs(t - 3.5) / 3.5;
  }
  const breathe = Math.sin((f + seed * 20) / 38) * 0.012;
  const tr = expr.tremble;
  const trem: V3 = [noise1(f * 0.9, seed) * 0.012 * tr, noise1(f * 1.1, seed + 3) * 0.008 * tr, 0];
  const B = BUILD[L.build];
  const sq = pose.squash;
  const pelvis = new Vector3(pose.pelvis[0], BODY.pelvisH + pose.pelvis[1], pose.pelvis[2]);

  const legs = ([1, -1] as const).map((s) => {
    const hip = pelvis.clone().add(new Vector3(s * BODY.hipX, BODY.hipY, 0));
    const [knee, ankle] = solveIK(hip, v3(s === 1 ? pose.footL : pose.footR), BODY.thigh, BODY.shin, v3(s === 1 ? pose.kneeL : pose.kneeR));
    return { s, hip, knee, ankle };
  });
  const arms = ([1, -1] as const).map((s) => {
    const sh = new Vector3(s * BODY.shoulderX * B.torso[0], BODY.shoulderY + pose.shrug * 0.06, 0);
    const [elbow, wrist] = solveIK(sh, v3(s === 1 ? pose.handL : pose.handR), BODY.upperArm, BODY.foreArm, v3(s === 1 ? pose.elbowL : pose.elbowR));
    return { s, sh, elbow, wrist };
  });
  const top = L.topSw;
  const skin = L.skin;
  const long = LONG_SLEEVES[L.top];
  const torsoGeo = G.lathe(`torso_${L.top}`, PROFILES[L.top]);
  const legSw = (part: "thigh" | "shin"): SwatchKey => (L.bottom === "pants" ? L.bottomSw : L.bottom === "shorts" ? (part === "thigh" ? L.bottomSw : skin) : skin);
  const sc = B.scale;
  const blush = Math.max(expr.blush, L.blush);
  const spineX = pose.spine[0] + B.spine;
  return (
    <group position={pose.pos} rotation={[0, pose.rotY, 0]} scale={[sc / Math.sqrt(sq), sc * sq, sc / Math.sqrt(sq)]}>
      {shadow && !bust ? (
        <Toon geo={G.circle()} sw="ink" mat={{ dotOnly: true, pattern: 0.42 }} outline={0} position={[0, 0.006, 0.02]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[0.55, 0.42, 1]} />
      ) : null}
      {!bust && legs.map(({ s, hip, knee, ankle }) => (
        <group key={s}>
          <Seg a={hip} b={knee} r0={L.bottom === "shorts" ? 0.13 : 0.125} r1={0.108} sw={legSw("thigh")} />
          <Ball p={knee} r={0.105} sw={legSw("shin")} />
          <Seg a={knee} b={ankle} r0={0.104} r1={0.088} sw={legSw("shin")} />
          <group position={[ankle.x, ankle.y, ankle.z]}>
            <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={L.shoes} mat={{ spec: 0.8, specSize: 0.05 }} outline={3.5} position={[0, -0.01, 0.06]} scale={[0.105, 0.08, 0.175]} />
            <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="white" outline={3} position={[0, -0.055, 0.065]} scale={[0.11, 0.03, 0.18]} />
          </group>
        </group>
      ))}
      <group position={[pelvis.x, pelvis.y, pelvis.z]}>
        {!bust && <Toon geo={G.lathe("pelvis", [[0, -0.22], [0.2, -0.21], [0.27, -0.12], [0.28, 0.0], [0.27, 0.06], [0, 0.08]])} sw={L.bottomSw} outline={3.5} scale={[B.torso[0], 1, 0.74 * B.torso[2]]} />}
        {!bust && L.bottom === "skirt" && L.top !== "dress" ? (
          <Toon geo={G.lathe("skirt", [[0, -0.6], [0.44, -0.6], [0.4, -0.38], [0.32, -0.12], [0.29, 0.04], [0, 0.06]])} sw={L.bottomSw} outline={4} scale={[B.torso[0], 1, 0.8 * B.torso[2]]} />
        ) : null}
        {/* torso space */}
        <group rotation={[spineX + breathe * 0.5, pose.spine[1], pose.spine[2]]}>
          <group visible={!bust} scale={[(1 + breathe * 0.4) * B.torso[0], 1, (1 + breathe * 0.6) * B.torso[2]]}>
            <Toon geo={torsoGeo} sw={top} outline={4} scale={[1, 1, 0.7]} />
            {L.top === "jacket" ? (
              <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(0.09, 0.62, 0.03, 0.012)} sw={L.innerSw} outline={2.5} position={[0, 0.37, 0.205]} rotation={[-0.06, 0, 0]} />
            ) : null}
            {L.top === "hoodie" ? (
              <>
                <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(0.34, 0.16, 0.04, 0.03)} sw={top} outline={3} position={[0, 0.16, 0.205]} rotation={[-0.08, 0, 0]} />
                {([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
                  <Toon key={s} geo={G.capsule(0.009, 0.14)} sw={L.innerSw} mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[s * 0.06, 0.6, 0.215]} rotation={[-0.15, 0, 0]} />
                ))}
              </>
            ) : null}
            {L.top === "shirt" ? (
              [0.18, 0.34, 0.5].map((y) => <Toon key={y} geo={G.sphereLo()} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, y, 0.205]} scale={0.014} />)
            ) : null}
          </group>
          {L.top === "tee" || L.top === "longsleeve" ? (
            <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.12, 0.022, Math.PI * 2)} sw={top} outline={2.5} position={[0, 0.8, 0.0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2 + 0.1, 0, 0]} scale={[1, 0.75, 1]} />
          ) : null}
          {L.top === "shirt" || L.top === "jacket" ? (
            ([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
              <Toon key={s} geo={G.roundedBox(0.12, 0.09, 0.02, 0.01)} sw={L.top === "jacket" ? top : L.innerSw} outline={2.5} position={[s * 0.08, 0.78, 0.11]} rotation={[-0.5, s * 0.5, s * 0.55]} />
            ))
          ) : null}
          {L.top === "hoodie" ? <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.17, 0.065, Math.PI * 2)} sw={top} outline={3.5} position={[0, 0.82, -0.08]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2 - 0.5, 0, 0]} scale={[1, 0.8, 1]} /> : null}
          {L.tie ? (
            <group position={[0, 0.6, 0.215]} rotation={[-0.12, 0, 0]}>
              <Toon geo={G.cone(4)} sw="red" outline={2.5} position={[0, -0.12, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI, Math.PI / 4, 0]} scale={[0.05, 0.28, 0.012]} />
              <Toon geo={G.sphereLo()} sw="red" outline={2} position={[0, 0.08, 0]} scale={[0.035, 0.03, 0.02]} />
            </group>
          ) : null}
          <Seg a={new Vector3(0, BODY.neckY - 0.06, 0)} b={new Vector3(0, BODY.headPivotY + 0.06, 0.01)} r0={0.075} r1={0.07} sw={skin} ink={3} />
          {!bust && arms.map(({ s, sh, elbow, wrist }) => {
            const sleeveEnd = sh.clone().lerp(elbow, 0.55);
            const cuff = elbow.clone().lerp(wrist, 0.86);
            return (
              <group key={s}>
                <Ball p={sh} r={0.092} sw={top} />
                <Seg a={sh} b={elbow} r0={0.072} r1={0.066} sw={long ? top : skin} ink={3.2} />
                {!long ? <Seg a={sh} b={sleeveEnd} r0={0.1} r1={0.096} sw={top} double ink={3.5} /> : null}
                <Ball p={elbow} r={0.066} sw={long ? top : skin} ink={3.2} />
                {long ? (
                  <>
                    <Seg a={elbow} b={cuff} r0={0.066} r1={0.06} sw={top} ink={3.2} />
                    <Seg a={cuff} b={wrist} r0={0.054} r1={0.052} sw={skin} ink={3} />
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Seg a={elbow} b={wrist} r0={0.064} r1={0.054} sw={skin} ink={3.2} />
                )}
                <Ball p={wrist} r={0.052} sw={skin} ink={3} />
                <Hand side={s} elbow={elbow} wrist={wrist} twist={s === 1 ? pose.twistL : pose.twistR} fist={s === 1 ? pose.fistL : pose.fistR} skin={skin} />
                {(s === 1 ? heldL : heldR) ? (
                  <group
                    position={[wrist.x + (s === 1 ? holdOffL : holdOffR)[0], wrist.y + (s === 1 ? holdOffL : holdOffR)[1], wrist.z + (s === 1 ? holdOffL : holdOffR)[2]]}
                    rotation={s === 1 ? holdRotL : holdRotR}
                  >
                    {s === 1 ? heldL : heldR}
                  </group>
                ) : null}
              </group>
            );
          })}
          {L.hair === "hijab" && !bust ? (
            <Toon geo={G.lathe("drape", [[0.0, 0.4], [0.3, 0.4], [0.355, 0.47], [0.375, 0.6], [0.33, 0.75], [0.23, 0.9], [0.15, 1.0], [0.1, 1.09], [0.0, 1.1]])} sw={L.hairSw} outline={4} scale={[B.torso[0], 1, 0.72 * B.torso[2]]} />
          ) : null}
          {torsoExtras}
          {/* head */}
          <group position={[trem[0], BODY.headPivotY + trem[1], 0.01]} rotation={[pose.head[0] - B.spine * 0.6, pose.head[1], pose.head[2], "YXZ"]} scale={B.head}>
            <group position={[0, BODY.headUp, 0.02]}>
              <Toon geo={G.head()} sw={skin} mat={{ cut: 0.08 }} outline={4.2} scale={[R, R, R * 0.92]} />
              {showsEars(L.hair) ? (
                <>
                  <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={skin} outline={3} position={[0.392, -0.02, -0.01]} scale={[0.05, 0.09, 0.07]} />
                  <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={skin} outline={3} position={[-0.392, -0.02, -0.01]} scale={[0.05, 0.09, 0.07]} />
                </>
              ) : null}
              <Hair look={L} />
              {expr.puff > 0.02
                ? ([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
                    <Toon key={s} geo={G.sphere()} sw={skin} outline={3} position={[s * 0.17, -0.17, surfZ(0.17, -0.17) - 0.07 + 0.025 * expr.puff * (1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(f * 0.55))]} scale={0.08 * expr.puff} />
                  ))
                : null}
              {blush > 0.02
                ? ([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
                    <Toon
                      key={`b${s}`}
                      geo={G.circle()}
                      sw={{ c: SW.red.c, s: SW.red.c, d: SW.red.c }}
                      mat={{ dotOnly: true, pattern: 0.5 }}
                      outline={0}
                      position={[s * 0.235, -0.1, surfZ(0.235, -0.1) + 0.02]}
                      rotation={[0, faceYaw(0.235, -0.1) * 1.1, 0]}
                      scale={[0.065 * blush, 0.045 * blush, 1]}
                    />
                  ))
                : null}
              <Eye side={1} e={expr} open={open} lashes={L.lashes} />
              <Eye side={-1} e={expr} open={open} lashes={L.lashes} />
              <Brow side={1} e={expr} w={L.browW} sw={L.hair === "bald" || L.hairSw === "hairGrey" ? "grey" : "ink"} />
              <Brow side={-1} e={expr} w={L.browW} sw={L.hair === "bald" || L.hairSw === "hairGrey" ? "grey" : "ink"} />
              <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={skin} outline={2.5} position={[0, -0.085, surfZ(0, -0.085) - 0.012]} scale={[0.042, 0.038, 0.045]} />
              {L.mustache ? <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.022, 0.09)} sw={L.hair === "hijab" ? "hair" : L.hairSw} mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, -0.14, surfZ(0, -0.14) + 0.01]} rotation={[0.3, 0, Math.PI / 2]} /> : null}
              {L.beard ? <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw={L.hairSw} mat={hm} outline={3} position={[0, -0.31, surfZ(0, -0.31) - 0.07]} scale={[0.19, 0.1, 0.12]} /> : null}
              <Mouth e={expr} f={f} />
              {L.glasses ? <Glasses sw={L.glasses} /> : null}
              {expr.sweat > 0.05 ? (
                <>
                  <Drop p={[0.31, 0.2, surfZ(0.31, 0.2) + 0.02]} f={f} phase={0} s={Math.min(1, expr.sweat * 1.4)} />
                  {expr.sweat > 0.6 ? <Drop p={[-0.33, 0.12, surfZ(-0.33, 0.12) + 0.02]} f={f} phase={33} s={(expr.sweat - 0.6) * 2.5} /> : null}
                </>
              ) : null}
              {expr.tears > 0.05
                ? ([1, -1] as const).map((s) => (
                    <group key={`t${s}`}>
                      <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.02, 0.16)} sw="sky" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.08 }} outline={2.5} position={[s * 0.17, -0.14, surfZ(0.17, -0.14) + 0.02]} scale={[expr.tears, expr.tears, 0.6]} />
                      <Drop p={[s * 0.17, -0.25, surfZ(0.17, -0.25) + 0.03]} f={f} phase={s * 20} s={expr.tears * 0.8} fall={0.18} period={30} />
                    </group>
                  ))
                : null}
              {headExtras}
            </group>
          </group>
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

==== 3231 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/ComicStage.tsx
import React, { useContext, useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { ThreeCanvas } from "@remotion/three";
import { useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { PerspectiveCamera, Vector2, Vector3 } from "three";
import { RenderScaleCtx, StageCtx, type V3 } from "./Toon.tsx";
import { DEFAULT_CELL, DEFAULT_LIGHT } from "./materials.ts";
import type { CamState } from "../camera.ts";
export { sampleCam, CAM0, type CamKey, type CamState } from "../camera.ts";

// ── ComicCamera ──

/**
 * Dolly-zoom helper: camera distance that keeps a subject of `size` world units filling the same
 * fraction of frame height while the fov changes (Hitchcock "vertigo" move).
 */
export const dollyDistance = (size: number, fov: number, frac = 0.5) => size / frac / (2 * Math.tan((fov * Math.PI) / 360));

const CameraRig: React.FC<{ cam: CamState; shake?: V3 }> = ({ cam, shake = [0, 0, 0] }) => {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera) as PerspectiveCamera;
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    camera.position.set(cam.pos[0] + shake[0], cam.pos[1] + shake[1], cam.pos[2] + shake[2]);
    const fwd = new Vector3(...cam.target).sub(camera.position).normalize();
    const right = new Vector3().crossVectors(fwd, new Vector3(0, 1, 0)).normalize();
    const up = new Vector3().crossVectors(right, fwd).normalize();
    camera.up.copy(up.multiplyScalar(Math.cos(cam.roll)).addScaledVector(right, Math.sin(cam.roll)));
    camera.lookAt(cam.target[0] + shake[0], cam.target[1] + shake[1], cam.target[2] + shake[2]);
    camera.fov = cam.fov;
    camera.near = 0.05;
    camera.far = 200;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  });
  return null;
};

// ── ComicStage: one WebGL canvas with comic stage context ─────────────────────────────────────
export type ComicStageProps = {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  frame: number;
  cam: CamState;
  shake?: V3;
  light?: V3;
  bg?: string;
  cell?: number;
  ink?: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  children: React.ReactNode;
};

export const ComicStage: React.FC<ComicStageProps> = ({
  width,
  height,
  frame,
  cam,
  shake,
  light = DEFAULT_LIGHT,
  bg = "#F6E8C8",
  cell = DEFAULT_CELL,
  ink = 1,
  style,
  children,
}) => {
  // previews draw the same 1080-space layout at a lower device-pixel ratio: ink widths stay in layout
  // pixels (uRes = layout size) and the halftone cell scales with the device pixels, so the look is identical
  const scale = useContext(RenderScaleCtx);
  const res = useMemo(() => new Vector2(width, height), [width, height]);
  const ctx = useMemo(() => ({ light, res, cell: cell * scale, frame, ink }), [light, res, cell, scale, frame, ink]);
  return (
    <ThreeCanvas
      width={width}
      height={height}
      dpr={scale}
      flat
      gl={{ antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true, powerPreference: "high-performance" }}
      style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, ...style }}
    >
      <color attach="background" args={[bg]} />
      <StageCtx.Provider value={ctx}>
        <CameraRig cam={cam} shake={shake} />
        {children}
      </StageCtx.Provider>
    </ThreeCanvas>
  );
};

==== 8036 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/geometries.ts
import {
  BufferGeometry,
  CapsuleGeometry,
  CatmullRomCurve3,
  CylinderGeometry,
  ExtrudeGeometry,
  LatheGeometry,
  Shape,
  SphereGeometry,
  TorusGeometry,
  TubeGeometry,
  Vector2,
  Vector3,
  ConeGeometry,
  CircleGeometry,
  PlaneGeometry,
} from "three";
import { mergeVertices } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from "three/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js";

// Shared, cached geometry. Every geometry has a matching "hull" with welded, averaged normals so the
// screen-space ink extrusion never cracks open at hard edges (boxes, extrusions, caps).

const cache = new Map<string, BufferGeometry>();
const hulls = new WeakMap<BufferGeometry, BufferGeometry>();

export const memoGeo = (key: string, make: () => BufferGeometry) => {
  let g = cache.get(key);
  if (!g) {
    g = make();
    g.computeBoundingSphere();
    cache.set(key, g);
  }
  return g;
};

export const hullOf = (g: BufferGeometry) => {
  let h = hulls.get(g);
  if (!h) {
    const pos = g.getAttribute("position");
    const bare = new BufferGeometry();
    bare.setAttribute("position", pos.clone());
    if (g.index) bare.setIndex(g.index.clone());
    h = mergeVertices(bare, 1e-4);
    h.computeVertexNormals();
    hulls.set(g, h);
  }
  return h;
};

const smoothProfile = (pts: [number, number][], n: number) => {
  const curve = new CatmullRomCurve3(pts.map(([x, y]) => new Vector3(x, y, 0)), false, "centripetal");
  return curve.getPoints(n).map((p) => new Vector2(Math.max(0, p.x), p.y));
};

// Unit egg-shaped head, R = 1, chin at y≈-0.95, crown at y≈1.02 (later scaled per character).
export const HEAD_PROFILE: [number, number][] = [
  [0.0, -0.96],
  [0.36, -0.9],
  [0.64, -0.7],
  [0.84, -0.42],
  [0.96, -0.1],
  [1.0, 0.18],
  [0.96, 0.48],
  [0.84, 0.74],
  [0.6, 0.93],
  [0.3, 1.01],
  [0.0, 1.03],
];
export const headRadiusAt = (y: number) => {
  const p = HEAD_PROFILE;
  if (y <= p[0][1]) return 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < p.length; i++) {
    if (y <= p[i][1]) {
      const t = (y - p[i - 1][1]) / (p[i][1] - p[i - 1][1]);
      return p[i - 1][0] + (p[i][0] - p[i - 1][0]) * t;
    }
  }
  return 0;
};

export const G = {
  sphere: () => memoGeo("sphere", () => new SphereGeometry(1, 40, 28)),
  sphereLo: () => memoGeo("sphereLo", () => new SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14)),
  /** unit cylinder along +Y from y=0 to y=1, radius top rT / bottom rB (relative) */
  limb: (rTop = 1, rBot = 1) =>
    memoGeo(`limb${rTop}_${rBot}`, () => {
      const g = new CylinderGeometry(rTop, rBot, 1, 28, 1, true);
      g.translate(0, 0.5, 0);
      return g;
    }),
  cylinder: (rTop = 1, rBot = 1, seg = 32) =>
    memoGeo(`cyl${rTop}_${rBot}_${seg}`, () => new CylinderGeometry(rTop, rBot, 1, seg, 1, false)),
  capsule: (r: number, len: number) => memoGeo(`cap${r}_${len}`, () => new CapsuleGeometry(r, len, 8, 20)),
  head: () =>
    memoGeo("head", () => {
      const g = new LatheGeometry(smoothProfile(HEAD_PROFILE, 40), 56);
      return g;
    }),
  lathe: (key: string, pts: [number, number][], seg = 48) =>
    memoGeo(`lathe_${key}`, () => new LatheGeometry(smoothProfile(pts, 36), seg)),
  roundedBox: (w: number, h: number, d: number, r: number) =>
    memoGeo(`rbox${w}_${h}_${d}_${r}`, () => new RoundedBoxGeometry(w, h, d, 4, r)),
  torusArc: (radius: number, tube: number, arc: number) =>
    memoGeo(`tor${radius}_${tube}_${arc}`, () => new TorusGeometry(radius, tube, 10, 32, arc)),
  sphereCap: (key: string, thetaStart: number, thetaLength: number) =>
    memoGeo(`cap_${key}`, () => new SphereGeometry(1, 48, 32, 0, Math.PI * 2, thetaStart, thetaLength)),
  cone: (seg = 32) => memoGeo(`cone${seg}`, () => new ConeGeometry(1, 1, seg, 1, false)),
  circle: () => memoGeo("circle", () => new CircleGeometry(1, 48)),
  plane: () => memoGeo("plane", () => new PlaneGeometry(1, 1)),
  tube: (key: string, pts: [number, number, number][], r: number) =>
    memoGeo(`tube_${key}`, () => new TubeGeometry(new CatmullRomCurve3(pts.map((p) => new Vector3(...p))), 40, r, 10, false)),
  heart: () =>
    memoGeo("heart", () => {
      const s = new Shape();
      s.moveTo(0, -1);
      s.bezierCurveTo(-0.35, -0.62, -1.05, -0.25, -1.05, 0.32);
      s.bezierCurveTo(-1.05, 0.82, -0.55, 1.02, -0.27, 0.98);
      s.bezierCurveTo(-0.08, 0.95, 0, 0.78, 0, 0.66);
      s.bezierCurveTo(0, 0.78, 0.08, 0.95, 0.27, 0.98);
      s.bezierCurveTo(0.55, 1.02, 1.05, 0.82, 1.05, 0.32);
      s.bezierCurveTo(1.05, -0.25, 0.35, -0.62, 0, -1);
      const g = new ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 0.35, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.22, bevelSize: 0.16, bevelSegments: 6, curveSegments: 40 });
      g.center();
      g.computeVertexNormals();
      return g;
    }),
  /** half of the heart split along a jagged crack, side = -1 (left) or 1 (right) */
  heartHalf: (side: -1 | 1) =>
    memoGeo(`heartHalf${side}`, () => {
      const crack: [number, number][] = [
        [0, 0.66],
        [0.12, 0.4],
        [-0.1, 0.16],
        [0.14, -0.1],
        [-0.08, -0.38],
        [0.06, -0.66],
        [0, -1],
      ];
      const s = new Shape();
      if (side === -1) {
        s.moveTo(0, -1);
        s.bezierCurveTo(-0.35, -0.62, -1.05, -0.25, -1.05, 0.32);
        s.bezierCurveTo(-1.05, 0.82, -0.55, 1.02, -0.27, 0.98);
        s.bezierCurveTo(-0.08, 0.95, 0, 0.78, 0, 0.66);
        for (let i = 1; i < crack.length; i++) s.lineTo(crack[i][0], crack[i][1]);
      } else {
        s.moveTo(0, 0.66);
        s.bezierCurveTo(0, 0.78, 0.08, 0.95, 0.27, 0.98);
        s.bezierCurveTo(0.55, 1.02, 1.05, 0.82, 1.05, 0.32);
        s.bezierCurveTo(1.05, -0.25, 0.35, -0.62, 0, -1);
        for (let i = crack.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) s.lineTo(crack[i][0], crack[i][1]);
      }
      const g = new ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 0.35, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.22, bevelSize: 0.12, bevelSegments: 5, curveSegments: 32 });
      g.translate(0, 0, -0.175);
      g.computeVertexNormals();
      return g;
    }),
  extrude: (key: string, shape: () => Shape, depth: number, bevel = 0.02) =>
    memoGeo(`ext_${key}`, () => {
      const g = new ExtrudeGeometry(shape(), { depth, bevelEnabled: bevel > 0, bevelThickness: bevel, bevelSize: bevel, bevelSegments: 3, curveSegments: 24 });
      g.translate(0, 0, -depth / 2);
      g.computeVertexNormals();
      return g;
    }),
};

export const roundedRectShape = (w: number, h: number, r: number) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  const x = -w / 2;
  const y = -h / 2;
  s.moveTo(x + r, y);
  s.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  s.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  s.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  s.lineTo(x, y + r);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  return s;
};

/** Chat bubble with a tail at bottom-left (tail = -1) or bottom-right (tail = 1). */
export const chatBubbleShape = (w: number, h: number, r: number, tail: -1 | 1) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  const x = -w / 2;
  const y = -h / 2;
  s.moveTo(x + r, y);
  if (tail === -1) {
    s.lineTo(x + r * 0.2, y - h * 0.32);
    s.lineTo(x + r * 1.6, y);
  }
  s.lineTo(x + w - r * (tail === 1 ? 1.6 : 1), y);
  if (tail === 1) {
    s.lineTo(x + w - r * 0.2, y - h * 0.32);
    s.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  }
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  s.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  s.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  s.lineTo(x, y + r);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  return s;
};

/** n-point star outline (comic stars, star eyes, sparkles). */
export const starShape = (r1: number, r2: number, n = 5) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  for (let i = 0; i <= n * 2; i++) {
    const a = (i / (n * 2)) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 2;
    const r = i % 2 === 0 ? r1 : r2;
    const x = Math.cos(a) * r;
    const y = Math.sin(a) * r;
    if (i === 0) s.moveTo(x, y);
    else s.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  return s;
};

import React from "react";
import { Shape } from "three";
import { Toon } from "./Toon.tsx";
import { G, roundedRectShape, starShape } from "./geometries.ts";
import { Phone, Sign } from "./props.tsx";
import type { SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Object library — everyday things built from inked, cel-shaded primitives. Every item stands on
// y = 0 at its origin (wall items hang centred on their origin, facing +z). Sizes are in world
// units: a standing adult is ≈ 2.7 tall, a table top ≈ 0.86, a door ≈ 2.3.
// Stories place items through sets (`items: [{ type, pos, rot, scale, sw, sw2, text, … }]`).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export type ItemProps = { sw?: SwatchKey; sw2?: SwatchKey; text?: string; sub?: string; on?: boolean; n?: number; f: number; t?: number };
type Item = { render: (p: ItemProps) => React.ReactNode; desc: string; wall?: boolean };

const box = (w: number, h: number, d: number, r = 0.03) => G.roundedBox(w, h, d, Math.min(r, w / 2 - 1e-3, h / 2 - 1e-3, d / 2 - 1e-3));
const leg = (x: number, z: number, h: number, sw: SwatchKey, r = 0.035) => <Toon key={`${x}${z}`} geo={G.limb(1, 1)} sw={sw} outline={3} position={[x, 0, z]} scale={[r, h, r]} />;

const bolt = () => {
  const s = new Shape();
  [[0.1, 1], [-0.45, -0.05], [-0.05, -0.05], [-0.2, -1], [0.45, 0.15], [0.05, 0.15], [0.25, 1]].forEach(([x, y], i) => (i ? s.lineTo(x, y) : s.moveTo(x, y)));
  s.closePath();
  return s;
};
const arrowShape = () => {
  const s = new Shape();
  [[-0.15, -1], [0.15, -1], [0.15, 0.2], [0.45, 0.2], [0, 1], [-0.45, 0.2], [-0.15, 0.2]].forEach(([x, y], i) => (i ? s.lineTo(x, y) : s.moveTo(x, y)));
  s.closePath();
  return s;
};
const flame = () => {
  const s = new Shape();
  s.moveTo(0, 1);
  s.bezierCurveTo(0.25, 0.55, 0.62, 0.35, 0.55, -0.15);
  s.bezierCurveTo(0.5, -0.65, 0.2, -0.9, 0, -0.9);
  s.bezierCurveTo(-0.2, -0.9, -0.5, -0.65, -0.55, -0.15);
  s.bezierCurveTo(-0.6, 0.3, -0.2, 0.4, 0, 1);
  return s;
};

        <Toon geo={G.circle()} sw="night" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0.22, 0.16, 0.01]} scale={0.43} />
      </group>
    ),
  },
};
export type ItemType = keyof typeof LIB;
export const ITEM_TYPES = Object.keys(LIB);

// People as data (pure TS): stories describe each person as a Look; ComicCharacter renders it.
import type { SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

export type HairStyle = "quiff" | "short" | "buzz" | "bob" | "long" | "ponytail" | "bun" | "curly" | "hijab" | "cap" | "bald";
export type TopStyle = "tee" | "longsleeve" | "shirt" | "jacket" | "hoodie" | "tunic" | "dress";
export type BottomStyle = "pants" | "shorts" | "skirt";
export type Build = "kid" | "teen" | "adult" | "elder" | "big";

export type Look = {
  id: string;
  skin: SwatchKey;
  hair: HairStyle;
  hairSw: SwatchKey; // hair colour, or hijab / cap colour
  top: TopStyle;
  topSw: SwatchKey;
  innerSw: SwatchKey; // collar / shirt under a jacket / tie
  bottom: BottomStyle;
  bottomSw: SwatchKey;
  shoes: SwatchKey;
  build: Build;
  glasses: false | SwatchKey;
  mustache: boolean;
  beard: boolean;
  tie: boolean;
  lashes: boolean;
  blush: number; // resting blush 0..1
  browW: number;
};

  build: "adult",
  glasses: false,
  mustache: false,
  beard: false,
  tie: false,
  lashes: false,
  blush: 0,
  browW: 1,
};
export const look = (o: Partial<Look> & { id: string }): Look => ({ ...LOOK_DEFAULTS, ...o });

==== 6964 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/materials.ts
import { Color, DoubleSide, FrontSide, BackSide, ShaderMaterial, Vector2, Vector3, Vector4, type Side } from "three";
import { SW, INK, type Swatch, type SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

// Colour pipeline: swatch hexes are sRGB, three converts them to linear on input and the shaders convert
// back with <colorspace_fragment> on output (no tone mapping), so flat fills land on the exact palette hex.

const COMMON = /* glsl */ `
  float aastep(float th, float v) { float w = max(fwidth(v) * 0.75, 1e-4); return smoothstep(th - w, th + w, v); }
  // Screen-space Ben-Day dot field (45°), dot coverage = tone in [0,1]. Locked to the canvas pixel grid
  // so every surface in a shot prints with one coherent screen, like a real halftone plate.
  float dots(float tone, float cell) {
    vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy;
    const float a = 0.785398;
    vec2 q = mat2(cos(a), sin(a), -sin(a), cos(a)) * p / cell;
    vec2 g = fract(q) - 0.5;
    float d = length(g);
    float r = sqrt(clamp(tone, 0.0, 1.0)) * 0.64;
    float w = max(fwidth(d) * 0.8, 1e-4);
    return 1.0 - smoothstep(r - w, r + w, d);
  }
`;

const VERT = /* glsl */ `
  varying vec3 vN;
  varying vec3 vPos;
  varying vec2 vUv;
  varying vec3 vObj;
  void main() {
    vObj = position;
    vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    vPos = mv.xyz;
    vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
    vUv = uv;
    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
  }
`;

const FRAG = /* glsl */ `
  uniform vec3 uColor; uniform vec3 uShade; uniform vec3 uDot; uniform vec3 uSpecColor; uniform vec3 uRimColor;
  uniform vec3 uLight;     // world-space direction TO the key light
  uniform float uCut;      // cel terminator (n·l)
  uniform float uCell;     // halftone cell size in px
  uniform float uHalftone; // halftone strength
  uniform float uPattern;  // flat all-over Ben-Day tone (walls / print fills)
  uniform float uSpec; uniform float uSpecSize;
  uniform float uRim;
  uniform float uFlat;     // 1 = unlit graphic fill
  uniform float uOpacity;
  uniform float uDotOnly;  // 1 = print only the dot screen (graphic shadows, blush)
  uniform vec4 uClip;      // object-space front ellipse cut-out: (halfW, halfH, centreY, minZ); halfW<=0 = off
  varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vPos; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vObj;
  ${COMMON}
  void main() {
    if (uClip.x > 0.0 && vObj.z > uClip.w) {
      vec2 e = vec2(vObj.x / uClip.x, (vObj.y - uClip.z) / uClip.y);
      if (dot(e, e) < 1.0) discard;
    }
    if (uDotOnly > 0.5) {
      if (dots(uPattern, uCell) < 0.5) discard;
      gl_FragColor = vec4(uDot, uOpacity);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
      return;
    }
    vec3 N = normalize(vN);
    if (!gl_FrontFacing) N = -N;
    vec3 L = normalize((viewMatrix * vec4(uLight, 0.0)).xyz);
    vec3 V = normalize(-vPos);
    float ndl = dot(N, L);
    vec3 col = uColor;
    if (uFlat < 0.5) {
      float lit = aastep(uCut, ndl);
      col = mix(uShade, uColor, lit);
      // halftone fade across the terminator (lit side) ...
      float t1 = 1.0 - smoothstep(uCut, uCut + 0.42, ndl);
      col = mix(col, uShade, dots(t1 * 0.62, uCell) * lit * uHalftone);
      // ... and a deeper dot screen inside the core shadow
      float t2 = smoothstep(uCut - 0.05, uCut - 0.85, ndl);
      col = mix(col, uDot, dots(t2 * 0.55, uCell) * (1.0 - lit) * uHalftone);
      // hard comic specular
      vec3 H = normalize(L + V);
      col = mix(col, uSpecColor, aastep(1.0 - uSpecSize, dot(N, H)) * uSpec);
      // back rim (graphic kicker)
      float rim = aastep(0.62, 1.0 - max(dot(N, V), 0.0)) * aastep(0.0, -ndl + 0.25);
      col = mix(col, uRimColor, rim * uRim);
    }
    if (uPattern > 0.0) col = mix(col, uDot, dots(uPattern, uCell));
    gl_FragColor = vec4(col, uOpacity);
    #include <colorspace_fragment>
  }
`;

export type ComicMatOpts = {
  sw?: Swatch | SwatchKey;
  light?: [number, number, number];
  cut?: number;
  cell?: number;
  halftone?: number;
  pattern?: number;
  spec?: number;
  specSize?: number;
  specColor?: string;
  rim?: number;
  rimColor?: string;
  flat?: boolean;
  side?: "front" | "double" | "back";
  opacity?: number;
  dotOnly?: boolean;
  clip?: [number, number, number, number];
};

const sideOf = (s?: ComicMatOpts["side"]): Side => (s === "double" ? DoubleSide : s === "back" ? BackSide : FrontSide);
const col = (hex: string) => new Color().setStyle(hex);

export const DEFAULT_LIGHT: [number, number, number] = [-0.55, 0.75, 0.6];
export const DEFAULT_CELL = 9;

/** HalftoneMaterial: cel bands + screen-locked Ben-Day dots + hard spec. */
export const createComicMaterial = (o: ComicMatOpts = {}) => {
  const sw: Swatch = typeof o.sw === "string" ? SW[o.sw] : (o.sw ?? SW.paper);
  const L = new Vector3(...(o.light ?? DEFAULT_LIGHT)).normalize();
  return new ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uColor: { value: col(sw.c) },
      uShade: { value: col(sw.s) },
      uDot: { value: col(sw.d) },
      uSpecColor: { value: col(o.specColor ?? "#FFF7E6") },
      uRimColor: { value: col(o.rimColor ?? "#FFF7E6") },
      uLight: { value: L },
      uCut: { value: o.cut ?? 0.12 },
      uCell: { value: o.cell ?? DEFAULT_CELL },
      uHalftone: { value: o.halftone ?? 1 },
      uPattern: { value: o.pattern ?? 0 },
      uSpec: { value: o.spec ?? 0 },
      uSpecSize: { value: o.specSize ?? 0.04 },
      uRim: { value: o.rim ?? 0 },
      uFlat: { value: o.flat ? 1 : 0 },
      uOpacity: { value: o.opacity ?? 1 },
      uDotOnly: { value: o.dotOnly ? 1 : 0 },
      uClip: { value: new Vector4(...(o.clip ?? [0, 0, 0, 0])) },
    },
    vertexShader: VERT,
    fragmentShader: FRAG,
    side: sideOf(o.side),
    transparent: (o.opacity ?? 1) < 1,
  });
};

const OUTLINE_VERT = /* glsl */ `
  uniform float uWidth; uniform vec2 uRes;
  void main() {
    vec4 clip = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    vec3 nv = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
    vec4 nc = projectionMatrix * vec4(nv, 0.0);
    vec2 dpx = nc.xy * uRes;                // normal direction in pixel space
    float l = length(dpx);
    vec2 dir = l > 1e-6 ? dpx / l : vec2(0.0);
    // constant on-screen ink width, softened for very close geometry so lines never balloon
    clip.xy += dir * (2.0 * uWidth / uRes) * clip.w;
    gl_Position = clip;
  }
`;
const OUTLINE_FRAG = /* glsl */ `
  uniform vec3 uInk; uniform float uOpacity;
  void main() { gl_FragColor = vec4(uInk, uOpacity);
    #include <colorspace_fragment>
  }
`;

/** InkOutline: inverted-hull contour with constant pixel width (screen-space extrusion). */
export const createInkMaterial = (widthPx: number, res: Vector2, ink = INK, opacity = 1) =>
  new ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uWidth: { value: widthPx },
      uRes: { value: res },
      uInk: { value: col(ink) },
      uOpacity: { value: opacity },
    },
    vertexShader: OUTLINE_VERT,
    fragmentShader: OUTLINE_FRAG,
    side: BackSide,
    transparent: opacity < 1,
  });

==== 14274 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/props.tsx
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { DoubleSide, MeshBasicMaterial } from "three";
import { Toon, type V3 } from "./Toon.tsx";
import { G } from "./geometries.ts";
import { roundRect, useCanvasTexture } from "./canvasTexture.ts";
import { FONT_IMPACT, FONT_LETTER } from "../../theme/fonts.ts";
import { BLUE, INK, PAPER, RED, SW, TEAL, YELLOW, type SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

// ── hand-drawn squiggle "words" (comic convention for unreadable small lettering) ─────────────
export const drawScribble = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, x: number, y: number, w: number, seed: number) => {
  ctx.beginPath();
  let cx = x;
  let i = 0;
  while (cx < x + w - 10) {
    const ww = 18 + ((Math.sin(seed * 9.1 + i * 3.7) + 1) / 2) * 34;
    const end = Math.min(cx + ww, x + w);
    ctx.moveTo(cx, y);
    for (let px = cx; px <= end; px += 4) ctx.lineTo(px, y + Math.sin(px * 0.55 + seed) * 3.2);
    cx = end + 10;
    i++;
  }
  ctx.stroke();
};
const heartPath = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, cx: number, cy: number, s: number) => {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + s * 0.9);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 1.3, cy + s * 0.1, cx - s * 0.9, cy - s * 0.9, cx, cy - s * 0.35);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.9, cy - s * 0.9, cx + s * 1.3, cy + s * 0.1, cx, cy + s * 0.9);
  ctx.closePath();
};

// ── Phone with a live screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type ChatMsg = { from: "me" | "them"; text?: string; scribble?: number; reveal?: number };
export type PhoneScreen =
  | { kind: "chat"; title: string; messages: ChatMsg[]; typing?: number; read?: boolean }
  | { kind: "notif"; app: string; title: string; text: string; time?: string }
  | { kind: "balance"; label: string; amount: string; note?: string; alert?: boolean }
  | { kind: "lock"; time: string; date?: string; notif?: string }
  | { kind: "off" };

const drawScreen = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number, s: PhoneScreen) => {
  ctx.fillStyle = s.kind === "lock" ? "#1E3F6E" : "#F6E8C8";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  if (s.kind === "chat") {
    ctx.fillStyle = TEAL;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, 96);
    ctx.fillStyle = YELLOW;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(52, 50, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFF7E6";
    ctx.font = `700 34px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
    ctx.fillText(s.title, 92, 52);
    let y = 128;
    for (const [i, m] of s.messages.entries()) {
      const r = m.reveal ?? 1;
      if (r <= 0) continue;
      const mine = m.from === "me";
      ctx.font = `700 40px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
      const lines = m.scribble ?? 0;
      const bw = lines ? 300 : Math.min(w - 60, ctx.measureText(m.text ?? "").width + 50);
      const bh = lines ? 34 + lines * 30 : 76;
      const bx = mine ? w - bw - 18 : 18;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, r * 1.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = mine ? YELLOW : "#F9EDD4";
      roundRect(ctx, bx, y + (1 - r) * 24, bw, bh, 22);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = INK;
      if (lines) {
        ctx.lineCap = "round";
        for (let l = 0; l < lines; l++) drawScribble(ctx, bx + 22, y + 34 + l * 30 + (1 - r) * 24, l === lines - 1 ? 140 : bw - 44, l + i * 3);
      } else ctx.fillText(m.text ?? "", bx + 25, y + bh / 2 + (1 - r) * 24 + 2);
      if (!mine === false && s.read && i === s.messages.length - 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = BLUE;
        for (const off of [0, 12]) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(bx + bw - 44 + off, y + bh - 20);
          ctx.lineTo(bx + bw - 38 + off, y + bh - 13);
          ctx.lineTo(bx + bw - 26 + off, y + bh - 28);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      y += bh + 22;
    }
    if (s.typing !== undefined && s.typing >= 0) {
      const bx = 18;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#F9EDD4";
      roundRect(ctx, bx, y, 132, 64, 30);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
        const ph = Math.sin((s.typing - d * 6) * 0.22);
        ctx.fillStyle = INK;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bx + 36 + d * 30, y + 32 - Math.max(0, ph) * 8, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EADBB8";
    ctx.fillRect(0, h - 90, w, 90);
  } else if (s.kind === "notif") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EADBB8";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#F9EDD4";
    roundRect(ctx, 20, 150, w - 40, 210, 26);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = RED;
    roundRect(ctx, 40, 172, 56, 56, 14);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = INK;
    ctx.font = `700 28px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
    ctx.fillText(s.app, 110, 200);
    if (s.time) ctx.fillText(s.time, w - 110, 200);
    ctx.font = `700 38px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
    ctx.fillText(s.title, 44, 262);
    ctx.font = `700 30px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
    ctx.fillText(s.text, 44, 316);
  } else if (s.kind === "balance") {
    ctx.fillStyle = TEAL;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, 260);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFF7E6";
    ctx.font = `700 32px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
    ctx.fillText(s.label, 32, 80);
    ctx.font = `64px "${FONT_IMPACT}"`;
    ctx.fillStyle = s.alert ? YELLOW : "#FFF7E6";
    ctx.fillText(s.amount, 32, 170);
    if (s.note) {
      ctx.fillStyle = INK;
      ctx.font = `700 30px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
      ctx.fillText(s.note, 32, 320);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "#F6E8C8" : "#EADBB8";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 380 + i * 90, w, 90);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#cbb88f";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      drawScribble(ctx, 30, 425 + i * 90, 200, i * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = RED;
      ctx.font = `40px "${FONT_IMPACT}"`;
      ctx.fillText("-", w - 120, 425 + i * 90);
    }
  } else if (s.kind === "lock") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFF7E6";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = `150px "${FONT_IMPACT}"`;
    ctx.fillText(s.time, w / 2, 230);
    if (s.date) {
      ctx.font = `700 34px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
      ctx.fillText(s.date, w / 2, 330);
    }
    if (s.notif) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFF7E6";
      roundRect(ctx, 24, 420, w - 48, 110, 24);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = INK;
      ctx.font = `700 32px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
      ctx.fillText(s.notif, w / 2, 476);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }
};

export const Phone: React.FC<{ screen: PhoneScreen; case?: SwatchKey; position?: V3; rotation?: V3; scale?: number }> = ({ screen, case: caseSw = "red", position, rotation, scale = 1 }) => {
  const key = JSON.stringify(screen, (_k, v) => (typeof v === "number" ? Math.round(v * 20) / 20 : v));
  const tex = useCanvasTexture(400, 800, key, (ctx, w, h) => drawScreen(ctx, w, h, screen));
  const screenMat = useMemo(() => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, toneMapped: false }), [tex]);
  const offMat = useMemo(() => new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: "#1d2a3a", toneMapped: false }), []);
  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation} scale={scale}>
      <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(0.23, 0.44, 0.045, 0.035)} sw={caseSw} mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.03 }} outline={3.5} />
      <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(0.205, 0.415, 0.01, 0.03)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, 0, 0.02]} />
      <mesh position={[0, 0, 0.0262]} geometry={G.plane()} scale={[0.19, 0.38, 1]} material={screen.kind === "off" ? offMat : screenMat} />
      <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(0.07, 0.07, 0.02, 0.015)} sw="ink" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0.06, 0.15, -0.026]} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── Balloon cards: hand-inked speech / chat / thought balloons living in 3D space ─────────────
export type BubbleIcon = "?" | "!" | "?!" | "..." | "zzz" | "heart" | "Rp" | "$";
export type BubbleContent =
  | { kind: "text"; text: string; font?: string; px?: number; color?: string }
  | { kind: "squiggle"; lines: number }
  | { kind: "dots"; phase: number }
  | { kind: "icon"; icon: BubbleIcon; color?: string };
export type BubbleOpts = { w: number; h: number; tail?: "left" | "right" | "none"; fill?: string; content: BubbleContent };

const TAIL = 0.34;
export const drawBubbleCard = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, cw: number, ch: number, o: BubbleOpts) => {
  const bodyH = ch / (1 + TAIL);
  const lw = Math.round(cw * 0.022);
  const m = lw * 1.2;
  const x = m, y = m, w = cw - 2 * m, h = bodyH - 2 * m;
  const r = Math.min(w, h) * 0.38;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  if (o.tail === "right") {
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.82, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.86, y + h + bodyH * 0.18, x + w * 0.95, y + h + bodyH * 0.3);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.72, y + h + bodyH * 0.16, x + w * 0.64, y + h);
  }
  if (o.tail === "left") {
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.36, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.28, y + h + bodyH * 0.16, x + w * 0.05, y + h + bodyH * 0.3);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.14, y + h + bodyH * 0.18, x + w * 0.18, y + h);
  }
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = o.fill ?? "#F9EDD4";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.stroke();
  const c = o.content;
  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  if (c.kind === "text" || c.kind === "icon") {
    if (c.kind === "icon" && c.icon === "heart") {
      heartPath(ctx, x + w / 2, y + h / 2, h * 0.32);
      ctx.fillStyle = c.color ?? RED;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.8;
      ctx.stroke();
      return;
    }
    const text = c.kind === "text" ? c.text : c.icon === "zzz" ? "Zzz" : c.icon;
    const font = c.kind === "text" ? c.font ?? FONT_IMPACT : FONT_IMPACT;
    let px = c.kind === "text" ? c.px ?? Math.round(h * 0.62) : Math.round(h * 0.78);
    ctx.font = `${px}px "${font}"`;
    while (ctx.measureText(text).width > w * 0.8 && px > 16) {
      px -= 6;
      ctx.font = `${px}px "${font}"`;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = c.color ?? (c.kind === "icon" && (c.icon === "!" || c.icon === "?!") ? RED : INK);
    ctx.fillText(text, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + px * 0.06);
  } else if (c.kind === "squiggle") {
    ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.75;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (let l = 0; l < c.lines; l++) {
      const yy = y + h * (0.2 + (0.6 * l) / Math.max(1, c.lines - 1));
      drawScribble(ctx, x + w * 0.14, yy, l === c.lines - 1 ? w * 0.42 : w * 0.72, l * 1.7 + 2);
    }
  } else {
    for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
      const ph = Math.sin((c.phase - d * 6) * 0.22);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + w * (0.3 + d * 0.2), y + h / 2 - Math.max(0, ph) * h * 0.12, h * 0.11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
};
const bubbleKey = (o: BubbleOpts) => JSON.stringify([o.w, o.h, o.tail, o.fill, o.content.kind === "dots" ? { k: "dots", p: Math.round(o.content.phase) } : o.content]);
export const useBubbleTexture = (o: BubbleOpts) => {
  const cw = 1024;
  const ch = Math.round((cw * o.h * (1 + TAIL)) / o.w);
  return useCanvasTexture(cw, ch, bubbleKey(o), (ctx, w, h) => drawBubbleCard(ctx, w, h, o));
};

/** A balloon card in 3D: inked face + offset ink "print extrusion" behind it for depth. */
export const ChatBubble3D: React.FC<BubbleOpts & { position?: V3; rotation?: V3; scale?: number | V3; opacity?: number }> = ({ position, rotation, scale = 1, opacity = 1, ...o }) => {
  const tex = useBubbleTexture(o);
  const face = useMemo(() => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, toneMapped: false, side: DoubleSide, alphaTest: 0.02 }), [tex]);
  const back = useMemo(() => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, color: "#000000", transparent: true, toneMapped: false, side: DoubleSide, alphaTest: 0.02 }), [tex]);
  face.opacity = opacity;
  back.opacity = opacity;
  const s: V3 = typeof scale === "number" ? [scale, scale, scale] : scale;
  const H = o.h * (1 + TAIL);
  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation} scale={s}>
      <mesh geometry={G.plane()} material={back} position={[o.w * 0.035, -H / 2 + o.h / 2 - o.w * 0.04, -0.03]} scale={[o.w, H, 1]} />
      <mesh geometry={G.plane()} material={face} position={[0, -H / 2 + o.h / 2, 0]} scale={[o.w, H, 1]} renderOrder={2} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── Sign: an in-world inked card with lettering (shop signs, price tags, calendar pages, labels) ──
export const Sign: React.FC<{
  text: string;
  sub?: string;
  w?: number;
  h?: number;
  sw?: SwatchKey;
  ink?: string;
  font?: "impact" | "letter";
  position?: V3;
  rotation?: V3;
  scale?: number;
  depth?: number;
}> = ({ text, sub, w = 1, h = 0.4, sw = "paper", ink = INK, font = "impact", position, rotation, scale = 1, depth = 0.04 }) => {
  const bg = SW[sw].c;
  const tex = useCanvasTexture(1024, Math.round((1024 * h) / w), `${text}|${sub}|${bg}|${ink}|${font}`, (ctx, cw, ch) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
    ctx.fillStyle = ink;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    const fam = font === "impact" ? FONT_IMPACT : FONT_LETTER;
    let px = Math.round(ch * (sub ? 0.5 : 0.66));
    ctx.font = `${font === "letter" ? "700 " : ""}${px}px "${fam}"`;
    while (ctx.measureText(text).width > cw * 0.86 && px > 14) {
      px -= 6;
      ctx.font = `${font === "letter" ? "700 " : ""}${px}px "${fam}"`;
    }
    ctx.fillText(text, cw / 2, sub ? ch * 0.4 : ch / 2 + px * 0.05);
    if (sub) {
      ctx.font = `700 ${Math.round(ch * 0.2)}px "${FONT_LETTER}"`;
      ctx.fillText(sub, cw / 2, ch * 0.78);
    }
  });
  const mat = useMemo(() => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, toneMapped: false }), [tex]);
  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation} scale={scale}>
      <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(w + 0.04, h + 0.04, depth, Math.min(0.03, depth / 2))} sw={sw} outline={4} />
      <mesh geometry={G.plane()} material={mat} position={[0, 0, depth / 2 + 0.002]} scale={[w, h, 1]} />
    </group>
  );
};

export { PAPER };

// ── Body proportions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Stylised ~3.6-heads-tall figure. Limbs are solved with analytic two-bone IK every frame and drawn as
// tapered segments between joint positions, so arms and legs can never detach or break.
export const BODY = {

// ── Pose ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Character space: +Y up, character faces +Z, +X is the character's LEFT.
export type Pose = {
  pos: V3; // root on the ground
  rotY: number;
  squash: number; // 1 = neutral; >1 stretch, <1 squash (volume-preserving)
  pelvis: V3; // offset from standing pelvis (x, dy, z)
  spine: V3; // torso euler (x = bend forward, y = twist, z = side lean)
  head: V3; // head euler relative to torso (x = nod down, y = turn to own left, z = tilt)
  shrug: number;
  handL: V3; // wrist targets, torso space
  handR: V3;
  elbowL: V3; // elbow pole directions, torso space
  elbowR: V3;
  twistL: number; // hand twist around forearm
  twistR: number;
  fistL: number; // 0 open mitten → 1 fist
  fistR: number;
  footL: V3; // ankle targets, root space
  footR: V3;
  kneeL: V3; // knee pole directions, root space
  kneeR: V3;
};

// ── Two-bone IK ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const _v = new Vector3();
const _d = new Vector3();
const _b = new Vector3();
/** Returns [joint, end] for a chain root→joint→end of lengths a,b reaching for target, bending toward pole. */
export const solveIK = (root: Vector3, target: Vector3, a: number, b: number, pole: Vector3): [Vector3, Vector3] => {
  _d.copy(target).sub(root);
  let dist = _d.length();
  if (dist < 1e-5) {
    _d.set(0, -1, 0);
    dist = 1e-5;
  }
  _d.divideScalar(dist);
  const d = Math.min(dist, a + b - 1e-4);
  const dMin = Math.abs(a - b) + 1e-3;
  const dd = Math.max(d, dMin);
  const x = (a * a - b * b + dd * dd) / (2 * dd);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(a * a - x * x, 0));
  _b.copy(pole).addScaledVector(_d, -pole.dot(_d));
  if (_b.lengthSq() < 1e-8) _b.set(0, 0, 1).addScaledVector(_d, -_d.z);
  _b.normalize();
  const joint = new Vector3().copy(root).addScaledVector(_d, x).addScaledVector(_b, h);
  const end = new Vector3().copy(root).addScaledVector(_d, dd);
  return [joint, end];
};

const UP = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
/** Placement (position, quaternion, length) of a +Y unit segment from a to b. */
export const segment = (a: Vector3, b: Vector3) => {
  _v.copy(b).sub(a);
  const len = _v.length();
  const q = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(UP, len > 1e-6 ? _v.clone().divideScalar(len) : UP);
  return { pos: [a.x, a.y, a.z] as V3, q, len };
};
