      { type: "sign", pos: [0, 0.4, -2.2], text: "DISKON", sw: "yellow", scale: 1.2 },
    ],
  },
};
export type SetPresetName = keyof typeof SET_PRESETS;

==== 9315 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/sets.tsx
import React from "react";
import { Shape } from "three";
import { Toon, type V3 } from "./Toon.tsx";
import { G } from "./geometries.ts";
import { LIB, type ItemProps } from "./library.tsx";
import { CliffHalf, Spotlight } from "./storyProps.tsx";
import { sample } from "../keyframes.ts";
import type { ItemSpec, SetSpec } from "./setTypes.ts";
import type { SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

/**
 * Register a story's own elements (made for one script) next to the library items. Call it at the
 * top level of `src/pv-stories/<id>/elements.tsx`; the names become usable as set items and as
 * `item` props in that story.
 */
export const registerItems = (items: Record<string, { desc: string; render: (p: ItemProps) => React.ReactNode; wall?: boolean }>) => {
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(items)) LIB[k] = v;
};

/** One placed item (animated fields sampled at the shot frame). */
export const PlacedItem: React.FC<{ spec: ItemSpec; f: number }> = ({ spec, f }) => {
  const s = spec.keys ? { ...spec, ...sample<Partial<ItemSpec>>(spec.keys, f) } : spec;
  const item = LIB[s.type];
  if (!item) throw new Error(`PANELVERSE: unknown item "${s.type}" — use a library item or registerItems() it in the story's elements.tsx`);
  const rot: V3 = typeof s.rot === "number" ? [0, s.rot, 0] : s.rot ?? [0, 0, 0];
  const scale: V3 = typeof s.scale === "number" ? [s.scale, s.scale, s.scale] : s.scale ?? [1, 1, 1];
  return (
    <group position={s.pos} rotation={rot} scale={scale}>
      {item.render({ sw: s.sw, sw2: s.sw2, text: s.text, sub: s.sub, on: s.on, n: s.n, t: s.t ?? f / 60, f })}
    </group>
  );
};

// ── stage looks (abstract comic spaces) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const BurstBackdrop: React.FC<{ position: V3; scale: number; a: SwatchKey; b: SwatchKey; rays?: number; spin?: number }> = ({ position, scale, a, b, rays = 18, spin = 0 }) => (
  <group position={position}>
    <Toon geo={G.circle()} sw={a} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.12 }} outline={0} scale={scale} />
    {Array.from({ length: rays }, (_, i) => (
      <group key={i} rotation={[0, 0, (i / rays) * Math.PI * 2 + spin]}>
        <Toon geo={G.cone(3)} sw={b} mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, scale * 0.5, 0.01]} scale={[scale * 0.09, scale, 0.001]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI]} />
      </group>
    ))}
  </group>
);
const jag = () => {
  const s = new Shape();
  const pts: [number, number][] = [[0, 12], [0.6, 8], [-0.5, 4], [0.7, 0], [-0.6, -4], [0.5, -8], [0, -12]];
  s.moveTo(-30, 12);
  pts.forEach(([x, y]) => s.lineTo(x, y));
  s.lineTo(-30, -12);
  s.closePath();
  return s;
};

const Stage: React.FC<{ set: SetSpec; f: number }> = ({ set, f }) => {
  const a = set.a ?? "red", b = set.b ?? "yellow";
  switch (set.look ?? "burst") {
    case "burst":
      return (
        <group>
          <Toon geo={G.circle()} sw={a} mat={{ pattern: 0.25, cut: -1 }} outline={0} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={9} />
          <BurstBackdrop position={[0, 2.2, -5]} scale={9} a={a} b={b} rays={20} spin={f * (set.spin ?? 0.004)} />
        </group>
      );
    case "spotlight":
      return (
        <group>
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={a} mat={{ pattern: 0.3, cut: -1 }} outline={0} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[30, 30, 1]} />
          <Toon geo={G.circle()} sw={b} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.18 }} outline={0} position={[0, 0.01, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[1.35, 1.25, 1]} />
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={a} mat={{ pattern: 0.42, flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, 4, -6]} scale={[30, 14, 1]} />
          <Spotlight position={[0, 4.3, 0]} height={4.0} radius={1.35} swing={Math.sin(f * 0.05) * 0.03} />
        </group>
      );
    case "split":
      return (
        <group>
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={b} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.15 }} outline={0} position={[0, 3, -6]} scale={[60, 24, 1]} />
          <Toon geo={G.extrude("splitJag", jag, 0.02, 0)} sw={a} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.15 }} outline={6} position={[0, 3, -5.9]} />
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw="paper" mat={{ pattern: 0.12, cut: -1 }} outline={0} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[30, 30, 1]} />
        </group>
      );
    case "tunnel":
      return (
        <group>
          {Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => {
            const z = -((i * 2 + (f * 0.12) % 2) % 28);
            return <Toon key={i} geo={G.torusArc(3.2, 0.5, Math.PI * 2)} sw={i % 2 ? a : b} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.1 }} outline={5} position={[0, 2, z]} />;
          })}
        </group>
      );
    case "paper":
      return <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw="paper" mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.06 }} outline={0} position={[0, 3, -6]} scale={[60, 30, 1]} />;
    case "dots":
      return (
        <group>
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={a} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.38 }} outline={0} position={[0, 3, -6]} scale={[60, 30, 1]} />
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={a} mat={{ pattern: 0.25, cut: -1 }} outline={0} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[30, 30, 1]} />
        </group>
      );
    case "cliff":
      return (
        <group>
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={a === "red" ? "navy" : a} mat={{ pattern: 0.35, flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, -3, -12]} scale={[60, 40, 1]} />
          <CliffHalf side={-1} offset={(set.gap ?? 0) / 2} tilt={set.tilt ?? 0} drop={set.drop ?? 0} />
          <CliffHalf side={1} offset={(set.gap ?? 0) / 2} tilt={set.tilt ?? 0} drop={set.drop ?? 0} />
        </group>
      );
    case "void":
    default:
      return <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={a} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.1 }} outline={0} position={[0, 3, -8]} scale={[60, 30, 1]} />;
  }
};

const SKY: Record<string, SwatchKey> = { day: "sky", sunset: "orange", night: "night" };

/** Renders any SetSpec (interior / exterior / stage) plus its items. */
export const SetRenderer: React.FC<{ set: SetSpec; f: number }> = ({ set, f }) => (
  <group>
    {set.kind === "interior" ? (
      <group>
        <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={set.floor ?? "wood"} mat={{ pattern: set.floorDots ?? 0.1, cut: -1 }} outline={0} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[16, 12, 1]} />
        <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={set.wall ?? "blue"} mat={{ pattern: set.wallDots ?? 0.15, cut: -1 }} outline={0} position={[0, 3, -2.4]} scale={[16, 6, 1]} />
        {set.wainscot ? (
          <>
            <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(16, 1.1, 0.06, 0.02)} sw={set.wainscot} mat={{ pattern: 0.15 }} outline={3.5} position={[0, 0.55, -2.36]} />
            <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(16, 0.08, 0.1, 0.02)} sw="white" outline={3} position={[0, 1.12, -2.33]} />
          </>
        ) : (
          <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(16, 0.18, 0.08, 0.02)} sw="white" outline={3} position={[0, 0.09, -2.36]} />
        )}
        {(set.sideWall === "left" || set.sideWall === "both") && (
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={set.wall ?? "blue"} mat={{ pattern: (set.wallDots ?? 0.15) + 0.1, cut: -1 }} outline={0} position={[-4.2, 3, 2]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} scale={[9, 6, 1]} />
        )}
        {(set.sideWall === "right" || set.sideWall === "both") && (
          <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={set.wall ?? "blue"} mat={{ pattern: (set.wallDots ?? 0.15) + 0.1, cut: -1 }} outline={0} position={[4.2, 3, 2]} rotation={[0, -Math.PI / 2, 0]} scale={[9, 6, 1]} />
        )}
      </group>
    ) : null}
    {set.kind === "exterior" ? (
      <group>
        <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={SKY[set.time ?? "day"]} mat={{ flat: true, pattern: set.time === "night" ? 0.22 : 0.06 }} outline={0} position={[0, 8, -16]} scale={[80, 30, 1]} />
        {set.time === "sunset" ? <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw="pink" mat={{ flat: true, pattern: 0.2 }} outline={0} position={[0, 2.5, -15.9]} scale={[80, 6, 1]} /> : null}
        <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw={set.ground ?? "grey"} mat={{ pattern: 0.12, cut: -1 }} outline={0} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[60, 40, 1]} />
        {set.road ? (
          <group>
            <Toon geo={G.plane()} sw="dark" mat={{ pattern: 0.1, cut: -1 }} outline={0} position={[0, 0.01, 1.6]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[60, 3, 1]} />
            {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
              <Toon key={i} geo={G.plane()} sw="white" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[-11 + i * 2, 0.02, 1.6]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[0.9, 0.12, 1]} />
            ))}
            <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(60, 0.14, 0.3, 0.03)} sw="white" outline={3} position={[0, 0.07, 0.05]} />
          </group>
        ) : null}
      </group>
    ) : null}
    {set.kind === "stage" ? <Stage set={set} f={f} /> : null}
    {(set.items ?? []).map((it, i) => (
      <PlacedItem key={i} spec={it} f={f} />
    ))}
  </group>
);

/** Anchors a set exposes for actors (e.g. the cliff halves drift apart carrying the people on them). */
export const setAnchors = (set: SetSpec): Record<string, { pos: V3; rot: V3 }> => {
  if (set.kind === "stage" && set.look === "cliff") {
    const g = (set.gap ?? 0) / 2, t = set.tilt ?? 0, d = set.drop ?? 0;
    return { "cliff-left": { pos: [-g, -d, 0], rot: [0, 0, t] }, "cliff-right": { pos: [g, -d, 0], rot: [0, 0, -t] } };
  }
  return {};
};

==== 1379 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/setTypes.ts
// Set (environment) specs — pure data so stories can build and remix them from Node and the browser.
import type { Key } from "../keyframes.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../types.ts";
import type { SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

export type ItemSpec = {
  type: string; // a library item (see references/panelverse/elements.md) or a story's own element
  pos: V3;
  rot?: number | V3; // number = yaw (radians)
  scale?: number | V3;
  sw?: SwatchKey;
  sw2?: SwatchKey;
  text?: string;
  sub?: string;
  on?: boolean;
  n?: number;
  t?: number;
  /** animate any of the fields above over shot-local frames */
  keys?: Key<Partial<Omit<ItemSpec, "keys" | "type">>>[];
};

export type StageLook = "burst" | "spotlight" | "void" | "split" | "tunnel" | "paper" | "dots" | "cliff";
export type SetSpec = {
  kind: "interior" | "exterior" | "stage";
  // interior
  floor?: SwatchKey;
  floorDots?: number;
  wall?: SwatchKey;
  wallDots?: number;
  wainscot?: SwatchKey | null;
  sideWall?: "left" | "right" | "both" | "none";
  // exterior
  time?: "day" | "sunset" | "night";
  ground?: SwatchKey;
  road?: boolean;
  // stage
  look?: StageLook;
  a?: SwatchKey;
  b?: SwatchKey;
  spin?: number; // burst rotation speed
  gap?: number; // cliff: split width
  tilt?: number; // cliff: halves tilt
  drop?: number; // cliff: halves sink
  items?: ItemSpec[];
};

==== 16352 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/storyProps.tsx
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { DoubleSide, MeshBasicMaterial, Shape, ShapeGeometry } from "three";
import { Toon, type V3 } from "./Toon.tsx";
import { G, memoGeo } from "./geometries.ts";
import { useBubbleTexture, type BubbleOpts } from "./props.tsx";
import { EASES, clamp, hash, prog } from "../keyframes.ts";
import { shardsOf, type Pt, type Quad } from "../panels/geometry.ts";

// ── Thought cloud (volumetric puffs, union-inked) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const CLOUD: [number, number, number, number][] = [
  [0, 0, 0, 0.42],
  [0.42, 0.08, -0.05, 0.34],
  [-0.42, 0.05, -0.05, 0.34],
  [0.22, 0.3, -0.08, 0.32],
  [-0.22, 0.3, -0.08, 0.3],
  [0.65, -0.12, -0.1, 0.24],
  [-0.66, -0.12, -0.1, 0.24],
  [0.25, -0.24, 0.0, 0.28],
  [-0.26, -0.22, 0.0, 0.27],
];
export const ThoughtCloud: React.FC<{ position: V3; scale: number; f: number; sw?: "white" | "paper" }> = ({ position, scale, f, sw = "paper" }) => {
  if (scale <= 0.001) return null;
  return (
    <group position={position} scale={scale}>
      {CLOUD.map(([x, y, z, r], i) => {
        const wob = 1 + Math.sin(f * 0.12 + i * 1.7) * 0.03;
        return <Toon key={i} geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={{ cut: -0.25, halftone: 0.8 }} outline={5} position={[x, y, z]} scale={r * wob} />;
      })}
    </group>
  );
};

/** small puffs trailing from the head up to the cloud, popping in sequence */
export const ThoughtTrail: React.FC<{ from: V3; to: V3; f: number; at: number; gap?: number }> = ({ from, to, f, at, gap = 7 }) => (
  <group>
    {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => {
      const s = EASES.outBackBig(prog(f, at + i * gap, at + i * gap + 10)) * (0.07 + i * 0.035);
      const t = 0.22 + i * 0.26;
      const p: V3 = [from[0] + (to[0] - from[0]) * t, from[1] + (to[1] - from[1]) * t, from[2] + (to[2] - from[2]) * t];
      return s > 0.001 ? <Toon key={i} geo={G.sphere()} sw="white" mat={{ cut: -0.25 }} outline={4} position={p} scale={s} /> : null;
    })}
  </group>
);

// ── Steam puffs (anger / hot food), cyclic rise ───────────────────────────────────────────────
export const SteamPuffs: React.FC<{ origin: V3; f: number; count?: number; spread?: number; size?: number; rise?: number; period?: number; sw?: "white" | "paper" }> = ({
  origin,
  f,
  count = 4,
  spread = 0.35,
  size = 0.12,
  rise = 0.9,
  period = 48,
  sw = "white",
}) => (
  <group position={origin}>
    {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
      const t = ((f + (i * period) / count) % period) / period;
      const side = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const x = side * spread * (0.4 + 0.6 * t) + hash(i) * 0.05;
      const s = size * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, t * 1.15)) * (0.8 + 0.4 * ((i * 7) % 3) / 2);
      return s > 0.004 ? (
        <Toon key={i} geo={G.sphere()} sw={sw} mat={{ cut: -0.2 }} outline={3.5} position={[x, t * rise, 0.05 * side]} scale={[s * 1.1, s, s]} />
      ) : null;
    })}
  </group>
);

// ── Spotlight: hanging lamp, translucent light cone, floor pool ───────────────────────────────
export const Spotlight: React.FC<{ position: V3; height: number; radius: number; swing?: number }> = ({ position, height, radius, swing = 0 }) => (
  <group position={position} rotation={[0, 0, swing]}>
    <Toon geo={G.limb(1, 1)} sw="ink" outline={2} scale={[0.015, 3, 0.015]} />
    <Toon geo={G.cone(32)} sw="ink" mat={{ side: "double", spec: 1, specSize: 0.04, specColor: "#3d5f8a" }} outline={3} position={[0, -0.12, 0]} scale={[0.32, 0.36, 0.32]} rotation={[Math.PI, 0, 0]} />
    <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="yellow" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[0, -0.3, 0]} scale={[0.14, 0.06, 0.14]} />
    {/* light cone */}
    <Toon geo={G.cone(48)} sw={{ c: "#F5CC27", s: "#F5CC27", d: "#F5CC27" }} mat={{ dotOnly: true, pattern: 0.12, side: "back" }} outline={0} position={[0, -0.3 - height / 2, 0]} scale={[radius, height, radius]} rotation={[Math.PI, 0, 0]} />
  </group>
);

// ── Cliff halves for "hubungan kalian tamat" ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const CRACK: [number, number][] = [
  [0.05, -5],
  [-0.25, -3.6],
  [0.3, -2.4],
  [-0.2, -1.3],
  [0.25, -0.4],
  [-0.3, 0.5],
  [0.2, 1.4],
  [-0.15, 2.4],
  [0.3, 3.4],
  [0, 5],
];
const cliffShape = (side: -1 | 1) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  s.moveTo(side * 9, -5);
  for (const [x, z] of CRACK) s.lineTo(x, z);
  s.lineTo(side * 9, 5);
  s.closePath();
  return s;
};
export const CliffHalf: React.FC<{ side: -1 | 1; offset: number; tilt: number; drop: number }> = ({ side, offset, tilt, drop }) => {
  // shape is drawn in (x, z) and extruded downwards (−y)
  const top = G.extrude(`cliffTop${side}`, () => cliffShape(side), 0.22, 0.04);
  const body = G.extrude(`cliffBody${side}`, () => cliffShape(side), 4, 0.06);
  return (
    <group position={[side * offset, -drop, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, -side * tilt]}>
      <group rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <Toon geo={top} sw="yellow" mat={{ pattern: 0.08 }} outline={5} position={[0, 0, 0.11]} />
        <Toon geo={body} sw="brown" mat={{ pattern: 0.15 }} outline={5} position={[0, 0, 2.2]} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

// ── Heart that cracks in two ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const BreakingHeart: React.FC<{ position: V3; scale: number; crack: number; split: number; f: number }> = ({ position, scale, crack, split, f }) => {
  const beat = 1 + Math.max(0, Math.sin(f * 0.25)) * 0.06 * (1 - crack);
  if (split <= 0) {
    return (
      <group position={position} scale={scale * beat}>
        <Toon geo={G.heart()} sw="red" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.03 }} outline={5} />
        {crack > 0 ? (
          <Toon
            geo={G.tube("heartcrack", [
              [0, 0.66, 0.36],
              [0.12, 0.4, 0.38],
              [-0.1, 0.16, 0.39],
              [0.14, -0.1, 0.38],
              [-0.08, -0.38, 0.36],
            ], 0.035)}
            sw="ink"
            mat={{ flat: true }}
            outline={0}
            scale={[1, 1, 1]}
            position={[0, 0, 0]}
            visible={crack > 0.05}
          />
        ) : null}
      </group>
    );
  }
  const fall = EASES.in(clamp(split)) * 4;
  return (
    <group position={position} scale={scale}>
      {([-1, 1] as const).map((s) => (
        <Toon
          key={s}
          geo={G.heartHalf(s)}
          sw="red"
          mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.03 }}
          outline={5}
          position={[s * (0.08 + split * 0.9), -fall, 0]}
          rotation={[split * 0.6, 0, s * split * 1.1]}
        />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

// ── Shattering balloon: the balloon texture cut into wedges that fly apart ────────────────────
const SHATTER_QUAD: Quad = [
  [0, 1],
  [1, 1],
  [1, 0],
  [0, 0],
];
const SHATTER_CUTS = [0.03, 0.16, 0.31, 0.45, 0.57, 0.72, 0.86];
export const ShatterBubble: React.FC<BubbleOpts & { position: V3; rotation?: V3; scale?: number; t: number }> = ({ position, rotation, scale = 1, t, ...o }) => {
  const tex = useBubbleTexture(o);
  const mat = useMemo(() => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, side: DoubleSide, toneMapped: false, alphaTest: 0.02 }), [tex]);
  const H = o.h * 1.34;
  const impact: Pt = [0.46, 0.58];
  const pieces = useMemo(
    () =>
      shardsOf(SHATTER_QUAD, impact, SHATTER_CUTS).map((pts, i) =>
        memoGeo(`shard${i}`, () => {
          const s = new Shape();
          pts.forEach((p, k) => (k === 0 ? s.moveTo(p[0], p[1]) : s.lineTo(p[0], p[1])));
          const g = new ShapeGeometry(s);
          g.translate(-0.5, -0.5, 0);
          return g;
        }),
      ),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [],
  );
  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation} scale={scale}>
      {pieces.map((g, i) => {
        const ang = (i / pieces.length) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.4;
        const k = EASES.out(clamp(t));
        const dx = Math.cos(ang) * k * (0.5 + 0.2 * hash(i));
        const dy = Math.sin(ang) * k * 0.4 - t * t * 1.2;
        return (
          <mesh
            key={i}
            geometry={g}
            material={mat}
            position={[dx, -H / 2 + o.h / 2 + dy, k * 0.3 * hash(i + 3)]}
            rotation={[k * hash(i * 2) * 1.2, k * hash(i * 5) * 1.4, k * hash(i * 7) * 2]}
            scale={[o.w, H, 1]}
          />
        );
      })}
    </group>
  );
};

// ── Bakso set ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const BaksoBowl: React.FC<{ position: V3; f: number; balls?: number }> = ({ position, f, balls = 4 }) => (
  <group position={position}>
    {/* classic white bowl with red rim band */}
    <Toon geo={G.lathe("bowl", [[0, 0], [0.16, 0.0], [0.2, 0.03], [0.3, 0.16], [0.34, 0.27], [0.33, 0.28], [0.29, 0.17], [0.0, 0.12]], 48)} sw="white" mat={{ side: "double", cut: -0.1 }} outline={4} />
    <Toon geo={G.torusArc(0.335, 0.018, Math.PI * 2)} sw="red" outline={0} mat={{ cut: -0.3 }} position={[0, 0.265, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
    {/* broth */}
    <Toon geo={G.circle()} sw="broth" mat={{ pattern: 0.1, cut: -1 }} outline={0} position={[0, 0.235, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={0.3} />
    {/* noodles */}
    {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
      <Toon key={`n${i}`} geo={G.torusArc(0.12 + i * 0.03, 0.012, Math.PI * 1.2)} sw="noodle" outline={2} position={[0.04 * i - 0.04, 0.245, 0.02 * i]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, i * 1.3]} />
    ))}
    {/* bakso */}
    {Array.from({ length: balls }, (_, i) => {
      const a = i * 1.9 + 0.3;
      return <Toon key={`b${i}`} geo={G.sphere()} sw="bakso" mat={{ spec: 0.6, specSize: 0.02 }} outline={3.5} position={[Math.cos(a) * 0.14, 0.27, Math.sin(a) * 0.13]} scale={0.075} />;
    })}
    {/* green onion bits */}
    {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => (
      <Toon key={`g${i}`} geo={G.sphereLo()} sw="green" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={0} position={[hash(i) * 0.22, 0.25, hash(i + 9) * 0.2]} scale={[0.022, 0.008, 0.022]} />
    ))}
    <SteamWisps origin={[0, 0.27, 0.08]} f={f} height={0.09} spread={0.09} />
  </group>
);

export const Spoon: React.FC<{ withBakso?: boolean }> = ({ withBakso }) => (
  <group>
    <Toon geo={G.capsule(0.012, 0.22)} sw="white" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.05 }} outline={2.5} position={[0, 0.12, 0]} />
    <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="white" mat={{ spec: 1, specSize: 0.05 }} outline={2.5} position={[0, 0.27, 0.01]} scale={[0.05, 0.075, 0.018]} />
    {withBakso ? <Toon geo={G.sphere()} sw="bakso" mat={{ spec: 0.6, specSize: 0.02 }} outline={3} position={[0, 0.28, 0.05]} scale={0.055} /> : null}
  </group>
);

export const Table: React.FC<{ position: V3; w?: number; d?: number; h?: number }> = ({ position, w = 2.8, d = 1.3, h = 0.86 }) => (

    <Toon geo={G.roundedBox(0.1, h * 0.5, 0.1, 0.03)} sw="wood" outline={3} position={[w / 2 - 0.15, h * 0.25, d / 2 - 0.15]} />
  </group>
);

export const Bottle: React.FC<{ position: V3; sw: "red" | "ink" | "yellow" }> = ({ position, sw }) => (

export const Glass: React.FC<{ position: V3 }> = ({ position }) => (

  </group>

export const FloatingHearts: React.FC<{ origin: V3; f: number; at: number; count?: number }> = ({ origin, f, at, count = 3 }) => (
  <group position={origin}>
    {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
      const t = (f - at - i * 9) / 50;
      if (t <= 0 || t >= 1) return null;
      const s = Math.sin(Math.PI * t) * 0.07;
      return <Toon key={i} geo={G.heart()} sw="red" outline={3} position={[(i - 1) * 0.22 + Math.sin(t * 6 + i) * 0.04, t * 0.6, 0]} scale={s} />;
    })}
  </group>
);

/** vibration arcs around a buzzing phone (3D ink strokes) */
export const BuzzArcs: React.FC<{ position: V3; on: boolean; f: number; rotation?: V3 }> = ({ position, on, f, rotation }) =>
  on ? (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation}>
      {([-1, 1] as const).map((s) =>
        [0, 1].map((k) => (
          <Toon
            key={`${s}${k}`}
            geo={G.torusArc(0.2 + k * 0.07, 0.012, 0.9)}
            sw="ink"
            mat={{ flat: true }}
            outline={0}
            rotation={[0, 0, s === 1 ? -0.45 : Math.PI - 0.45]}
            visible={Math.floor(f / 3) % 2 === k}
          />
        )),
      )}
    </group>
  ) : null;

// ── Ground impact star (stomps, slams) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const spikyShape = (r1: number, r2: number, n: number, seed: number) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  for (let i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
    const a = (i / (n * 2)) * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = i % 2 === 0 ? r1 * (0.85 + 0.25 * (hash(seed + i) + 1) * 0.5) : r2;
    const x = Math.cos(a) * r;
    const y = Math.sin(a) * r;
    if (i === 0) s.moveTo(x, y);
    else s.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  s.closePath();
  return s;
};
export const ImpactStar: React.FC<{ position: V3; scale: number; rot?: number }> = ({ position, scale, rot = 0 }) =>
  scale > 0.001 ? (
    <group position={position} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, rot]} scale={scale}>
      <Toon geo={G.extrude("impactStar", () => spikyShape(1, 0.55, 11, 3), 0.04, 0.01)} sw="yellow" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={5} />
      <Toon geo={G.extrude("impactStar2", () => spikyShape(0.6, 0.34, 9, 8), 0.05, 0.01)} sw="white" mat={{ flat: true }} outline={4} position={[0, 0, 0.03]} />
    </group>
  ) : null;

// ── Steam wisps: classic inked S-curls rising and fading (hot food) ──────────────────────────
const WISP: [number, number, number][] = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => {
  const t = i / 8;
  return [Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2) * 0.035, t * 0.2, 0];
});
export const SteamWisps: React.FC<{ origin: V3; f: number; count?: number; spread?: number; height?: number; period?: number }> = ({
  origin,
  f,
  count = 3,
  spread = 0.1,
  height = 0.22,
  period = 64,
}) => (
  <group position={origin}>
    {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
      const t = ((f + (i * period) / count) % period) / period;
      const s = Math.sin(Math.PI * t);
      return s > 0.05 ? (
        <Toon
          key={i}
          geo={G.tube("wisp", WISP, 0.011)}
          sw="white"
          mat={{ flat: true }}
          outline={2.5}
          position={[(i - (count - 1) / 2) * spread, t * height, 0]}
          rotation={[0, 0, Math.sin(f * 0.08 + i * 2) * 0.25]}
          scale={[0.9, 0.35 + 0.35 * s, 0.9]}
          opacity={1}
          visible={s > 0.12}
        />
      ) : null;
    })}
  </group>
);

==== 3130 src/kits/panelverse/engine/three/Toon.tsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useMemo } from "react";
import { BufferGeometry, Vector2, type Euler, type Quaternion } from "three";
import { createComicMaterial, createInkMaterial, DEFAULT_CELL, DEFAULT_LIGHT, type ComicMatOpts } from "./materials.ts";
import { hullOf } from "./geometries.ts";
import type { Swatch, SwatchKey } from "../../theme/palette.ts";

import type { V3 } from "../types.ts";
export type { V3 };

/** Render scale of the whole film (1 = final 1080×1920, 0.5 = preview 540×960). */
export const RenderScaleCtx = createContext(1);

/** Per-canvas stage info shared by every comic mesh: key light, ink resolution, halftone cell, shot clock. */
export type StageInfo = {
  light: V3;
  res: Vector2;
  cell: number;
  /** shot-local frame (already frozen / remapped by the shot) */
  frame: number;
  /** global ink width multiplier (e.g. wider for close-ups) */
  ink: number;
};
export const StageCtx = createContext<StageInfo>({
  light: DEFAULT_LIGHT,
  res: new Vector2(1080, 1920),
  cell: DEFAULT_CELL,
  frame: 0,
  ink: 1,
});
export const useStage = () => useContext(StageCtx);
export const useShotFrame = () => useContext(StageCtx).frame;

export type ToonProps = {
  geo: BufferGeometry;
  sw?: SwatchKey | Swatch;
  mat?: Omit<ComicMatOpts, "sw" | "light" | "cell">;
  /** ink width in px; 0 disables the contour */
  outline?: number;
  inkColor?: string;
  position?: V3;
  rotation?: V3 | Euler;
  quaternion?: Quaternion;
  scale?: V3 | number;
  visible?: boolean;
  opacity?: number;
  renderOrder?: number;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
};

/** A cel-shaded, halftone-printed mesh with its own inverted-hull ink contour. */
export const Toon: React.FC<ToonProps> = ({
  geo,
  sw = "paper",
  mat,
  outline = 4,
  inkColor,
  position,
  rotation,
  quaternion,
  scale,
  visible = true,
  opacity = 1,
  renderOrder,
  children,
}) => {
  const st = useStage();
  const key = JSON.stringify([sw, mat, st.light, st.cell, opacity < 1]);
  const material = useMemo(
    () => createComicMaterial({ ...mat, sw, light: st.light, cell: st.cell, opacity: opacity < 1 ? opacity : 1 }),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [key],
  );
  material.uniforms.uOpacity.value = opacity;
  const ink = useMemo(
    () => (outline > 0 ? createInkMaterial(outline * st.ink, st.res, inkColor, opacity < 1 ? opacity : 1) : null),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [outline, st.ink, st.res, inkColor, opacity < 1],
  );
  if (ink) ink.uniforms.uOpacity.value = opacity;
  const hull = useMemo(() => (outline > 0 ? hullOf(geo) : null), [geo, outline]);
  const s: V3 | undefined = typeof scale === "number" ? [scale, scale, scale] : scale;
  return (
    <group
      position={position}
      rotation={rotation as V3 | undefined}
      quaternion={quaternion}
      scale={s}
      visible={visible && opacity > 0.001}
    >
      <mesh geometry={geo} material={material} renderOrder={renderOrder} />
      {ink && hull ? <mesh geometry={hull} material={ink} renderOrder={renderOrder} /> : null}
      {children}
    </group>
  );
};

export type V3 = [number, number, number];

==== 1787 src/kits/panelverse/Films.tsx
import React from "react";
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import { StoryPlayer } from "./director/StoryPlayer.tsx";
import { Catalog, CATALOG_PAGES } from "./catalog/Catalog.tsx";
import { PV_STORIES } from "../../pv-stories/registry.ts";

const byId = (id: string) => {
  const s = PV_STORIES.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!s) throw new Error(`PANELVERSE story "${id}" is not registered (run scripts/pv-make.mjs)`);
  return s;
};
const Preview: React.FC<{ id: string }> = ({ id }) => <StoryPlayer story={byId(id)} step={2} scale={0.5} audio={`audio/${id}-mix.wav`} />;
const Final: React.FC<{ id: string }> = ({ id }) => <StoryPlayer story={byId(id)} />;
/** silent preview for stills (no audio file needed) */
const Stills: React.FC<{ id: string }> = ({ id }) => <StoryPlayer story={byId(id)} step={2} scale={0.5} />;

/** Every PANELVERSE story as `<id>-preview` (540×960 @ 30), `<id>-final` (1080×1920 @ 60), `<id>-stills`; plus the element catalog. */
export const PanelverseFilms: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    {PV_STORIES.map((s) => (
      <React.Fragment key={s.id}>
        <Composition id={`${s.id}-preview`} component={Preview} defaultProps={{ id: s.id }} durationInFrames={Math.ceil(s.durationInFrames / 2)} fps={30} width={540} height={960} />
        <Composition id={`${s.id}-stills`} component={Stills} defaultProps={{ id: s.id }} durationInFrames={Math.ceil(s.durationInFrames / 2)} fps={30} width={540} height={960} />
        <Composition id={`${s.id}-final`} component={Final} defaultProps={{ id: s.id }} durationInFrames={s.durationInFrames} fps={60} width={1080} height={1920} />
      </React.Fragment>
    ))}
    <Composition id="PanelverseCatalog" component={Catalog} durationInFrames={CATALOG_PAGES} fps={1} width={1080} height={1920} />
  </>
);

==== 1092 src/kits/panelverse/theme/fonts.ts
import { staticFile } from "remotion";

// All fonts are OFL-1.1 (Bangers, Luckiest Guy, Comic Neue), bundled in public/fonts — no network at render time.
export const FONT_IMPACT = "PV Bangers"; // classic comic display lettering
export const FONT_TITLE = "PV Luckiest Guy"; // chunky payoff titles
export const FONT_LETTER = "PV Comic Neue"; // speech / chat / caption lettering

const FILES: [string, string, string][] = [
  [FONT_IMPACT, "fonts/pv-Bangers.woff2", "400"],
  [FONT_TITLE, "fonts/pv-LuckiestGuy.woff2", "400"],
  [FONT_LETTER, "fonts/pv-ComicNeue-Bold.woff2", "700"],
];

let loaded: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
/** Loads the comic fonts once per page (FontFace API, no extra packages). */
export const ensureFonts = () => {
  if (!loaded) {
    loaded = Promise.all(
      FILES.map(async ([family, file, weight]) => {
        const face = new FontFace(family, `url(${staticFile(file)}) format("woff2")`, { weight });
        await face.load();
        (document.fonts as unknown as { add: (x: FontFace) => void }).add(face);
      }),
    );
  }
  return loaded;
};

// PANELVERSE retro pop palette. The core six are the style's identity; every other swatch is a
// hand-picked shade/dot companion in the same printed family so cel bands never drift off-palette.
export const INK = "#171717";
export const PAPER = "#F6E8C8";
export const YELLOW = "#F5CC27";
export const RED = "#EF4035";
export const BLUE = "#2674B9";
export const TEAL = "#1B927C";

/** A cel-shaded surface: lit flat colour, shadow band colour, halftone dot colour (deep shadow). */
export type Swatch = { c: string; s: string; d: string };

// Generated by scripts/pv-make.mjs — every story in src/pv-stories/<id>/ becomes two compositions.
import type { StoryDef } from "../kits/panelverse/director/types.ts";
